jobs.descriptionText: 🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH At Legion Health https://legionhealth.com/, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale. Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications https://nypost.com/2026/03/27/business/artificial-intelligence-can-now-prescribe-mental-health-drugs/, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens. Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients. Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV. Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together. 📍 ROLE LOGISTICS - Job Type: Full-Time - Role Type: Product Design / UX & UI / Brand / Growth Creative - Ideal Experience Level: 5+ years or equivalent evidence of exceptional shipped work - Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA 🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY Legion is hiring a Full-Stack Product Designer to own the experience from the first ad or landing page through onboarding and ongoing care. You will combine deep product design with strong visual, brand, and web craft, helping patients understand what Legion does, get into care, and feel confident about what comes next. You will work closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, and the founders. Your work will span patient experiences, clinician and operator tools, the website, landing pages, lifecycle touchpoints, and acquisition creative. A shared, prioritized backlog will make the tradeoffs between core product delivery and growth experiments explicit. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end design ownership: understand the problem, explore alternatives, prototype, craft the interface, contribute directly to implementation, and improve the shipped result. Full-stack means breadth across the design process and product/growth surfaces, including regularly shipping well-scoped production PRs in close partnership with Engineering. AI-native design is a core expectation of this role. You will use tools such as v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, and comparable tools throughout the design process—not as occasional add-ons, but as everyday tools for divergent exploration, interactive prototyping, implementation, and rapid iteration. ✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES - Translate user needs and complex care workflows into clear journeys, information architecture, interaction flows, prototypes, and polished interfaces. - Design patient onboarding and ongoing care experiences alongside clinician and operator workflows, with particular attention to clarity, trust, accessibility, and mobile usability. - Define complete interaction states, including loading, empty, error, permission, and recovery experiences; write clear interface copy and remove avoidable dead ends. - Build a practical design system with reusable components, patterns, and guidance that helps the team ship consistently and quickly. - Ship production PRs regularly. This is a product-design role—not a software-engineering role—but you are expected to work directly in the codebase and open production-quality PRs for well-scoped changes such as instrumentation, internal tools, workflow logic, UI and copy improvements, prototypes, and small fixes. You should be comfortable testing, reviewing, and safely rolling out your work in close partnership with engineering. - Bring Legion's brand to life across the website, landing pages, lifecycle communications, and acquisition creative. - Develop paid-creative concepts and experiment variants with Growth; use performance feedback to sharpen the message and improve the experience. - Use user research, usability testing, product analytics, and experiment results to identify friction and decide what to improve. - Connect acquisition promises with the product experience, creating a coherent path from first impression to activation and continued care. - Work AI-natively throughout the design process. Use v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, and comparable tools to generate and compare directions, build high-fidelity interactive prototypes, test ideas earlier, accelerate implementation, and shorten the loop from concept to shipped product—while applying strong judgment to every final decision. 🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU… - Ship clear, useful, visually excellent experiences that patients and teammates can use with confidence. - Improve usability, task completion, onboarding conversion, and adoption of the product surfaces you own. - Create faster design-to-engineering cycles with fewer avoidable implementation gaps and a reusable component foundation. - Deliver a steady cadence of thoughtful landing-page and creative experiments with explicit hypotheses and useful learning. - Earn trust as a partner who prioritizes well, explains tradeoffs clearly, and follows through on the shipped result. 🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS - A portfolio of shipped product work that shows the problem, your personal contribution, alternatives, tradeoffs, interaction detail, and outcomes. - Strong product-design depth and strong visual craft across typography, layout, brand, and web. We need evidence of both. - Experience taking ambiguous problems from discovery through polished UI and production collaboration with engineers. Comfortable working directly in a codebase, using Git and pull requests, testing well-scoped changes, and incorporating engineering review before a safe rollout. - Demonstrated fluency with AI-native design and prototyping workflows is required. You should be able to show how you have used v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, or comparable tools to materially improve the speed, breadth, fidelity, or quality of shipped work. - Website or landing-page work and the ability to develop effective acquisition creative; curiosity about what makes creative perform. - Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative evidence without reducing every design decision to a single conversion metric. - Clear writing, low ego, high ownership, and the ability to balance speed with quality in an early-stage team. - Experience in healthcare or another trust-sensitive consumer product is helpful. Sound judgment and strong shipped work matter most. 💰 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - Salary: $180,000 – $230,000 annual base salary, based on experience - Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company. - Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits - Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, learning stipend, and AI tooling budget - Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy - Work Setup: Full-time, onsite in San Francisco, CA - Impact: Own the design quality of a coherent care experience across product and growth. - Autonomy and Learning: Own your work end-to-end with close cross-functional and founder collaboration. - Growth Opportunities: Broaden your design leadership as Legion scales, while staying close to users and the work. 🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Product Designer - London
jobs.descriptionText: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them. - Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. - Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship. - Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. - Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers. WHAT WE THINK IT TAKES Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback. Likely a good fit if you - Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies. - Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive. - Have a portfolio that shows your latest work. - Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests. - Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new. - Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control. - Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers. - Are fluent in Figma. - Can work within a design system and contribute to it. Stronger still if you - Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces. - Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match. HOW WE HIRE Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our London office, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: Our Product Design team helps make complex workflows simple and intuitive for the people using Gearset every day. Product designers work closely with customers, product managers and engineers to understand problems, test ideas and learn from what we ship. You’ll join a team of product designers working across the Gearset platform, so you won’t be designing on your own. You’ll have people to pair with, share work and ideas with, and learn from, while still having ownership of the problems you’re working on. You’ll work on technically interesting problems at the heart of the Gearset platform, including pipelines that connect different parts of our customers’ workflows. You don’t need to arrive knowing Salesforce or DevOps inside out. Curiosity and an interest in learning technical concepts matter more. You’ll have the space and support to build that knowledge as you go. WHAT’S THE OPPORTUNITY FOR A PRODUCT DESIGNER AT GEARSET? - Take ownership of meaningful customer problems from discovery through to delivery, with the freedom to explore what’s worth solving, shape the approach, and learn from what happens once it’s live. - Support our Automation and Governance product group, working on customer problems around activation, time to value and complex workflows. - Get close to our customers and their day-to-day challenges, with the freedom to speak to real users whenever you need to and use research and product data to understand where design can make the biggest difference. - Work alongside product managers and engineers from the first conversation about a problem, bringing different perspectives together to explore, shape and develop the right solution as a team. - Design for people with different levels of technical knowledge, making complex workflows simpler for Salesforce admins, release managers and developers. - Build your technical knowledge as you go, with opportunities to work beyond Figma on coded prototypes, design system components and smaller product changes. - Explore how AI can support your design process and become part of the experiences we create for customers. - Have the autonomy to spot opportunities, investigate them and help shape what the team focuses on next. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Build a strong understanding of our customers through discovery and usability research, helping uncover the problems that are most valuable to solve. - Turn customer insights and product data into ideas, then work with product managers and engineers to explore and test the right approach. - Bring ideas to life through prototypes and research, learning directly from the people who’ll use what you design. - Work closely with engineers as designs become part of the Gearset platform, staying involved throughout rather than handing work over. - Hold a high bar for the experience we ship, judging work by whether it's useful, coherent and well made. - Share accountability for what happens after we ship, using customer feedback and product data to understand whether the work is being used and having the intended impact, then keep improving the experience. - Have the freedom to spot opportunities yourself, explore them and build the evidence for where we should focus next. - Contribute to the wider Product Design team by sharing work, exchanging feedback and supporting other designers through pairing and reviews. ABOUT YOU - You have experience designing and shipping digital products, with a portfolio that shows the problem you were solving, your approach and the outcome, not just the finished UI. - You’ve worked closely with product managers and engineers throughout the design process, bringing different perspectives together to find a way forward. - You have experience speaking directly with users, running research and using product analytics to understand customer problems and inform your decisions. - You can make complex workflows simple and intuitive, and you’re interested in learning the technical concepts behind the products you design. - You can manage multiple projects at different stages, use AI as part of your day-to-day workflow and use what you learn after something ships to inform what comes next. GREAT TO HAVES - Experience working on B2B SaaS, technical applications or developer products, or familiarity with Salesforce, DevOps, Git or version control. - Hands-on technical experience, such as working with code, HTML or CSS, creating coded prototypes, contributing to design systems or using platforms such as Amplitude, Figma, Notion or Claude. SALARY AND BENEFITS (THE STUFF YOU’D EXPECT!) - Salary is £50k - £80k (depending on experience) - This is a full time opportunity, working Monday to Friday either remotely in the UK or with the option of flexible hybrid working. - Generous personal development budget for courses, conferences, or whatever is useful to your professional development in the role of up to £1500 per year - Top end hardware provided - Opportunity to join our Long Term Incentive Plan - Free lunch in the office - 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (with the option to buy an extra 5 each year) - Company Pension Plan (matching up to 5%) - Bupa health care and dental insurance - Enhanced family leave from day 1, including 26 weeks full maternity/adoption pay, OTE-inclusive - Bupa Menopause Plan offering specialist consultations and support - Life Insurance & critical illness cover - Discounted gym membership, as well as a range of health and wellness benefits

jobs.descriptionText: About Us Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. About the Company Fanatics Collectibles is operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. Fanatics Collectibles is a leading producer and seller of physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and collectibles across sports and entertainment. Topps is one of the most recognized names in trading cards and collecting, with a heritage spanning generations of collectors across sports and entertainment. Fanatics Live brings together content, community, and commerce through creator-led live shopping experiences where fans and collectors can discover products, participate in live breaks, and connect around shared interests. Fanatics Collect gives collectors a place to shop, sell, vault, and manage their collections, bringing multiple parts of the collecting experience together in one platform. Together, these businesses are creating new ways for fans and collectors to connect with the sports, athletes, entertainment, and collectibles they love. Role Summary Fanatics Collectibles is looking for a curious, collaborative, and craft-focused Product Designer to help create engaging digital experiences across Topps, Fanatics Live, and Fanatics Collect . In this role, you’ll work alongside product designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, marketers, and creative partners to turn ideas and user needs into intuitive, engaging product experiences for fans and collectors. You’ll contribute throughout the design process—from exploring concepts and user flows to creating polished interfaces and supporting implementation. You’ll also partner closely with our Graphic Designer to bring together product usability and strong visual storytelling, helping create cohesive experiences across our products and brands. This is an opportunity for a designer who is building their product design career and wants hands-on experience working across digital products at the intersection of sports, collecting, community, content, and commerce. As part of Fanatics Collectibles’ continued global growth, we are establishing a new technology hub in Mexico City focused on operational excellence, platform scalability, trust, and customer experience. This team partners closely with Customer Experience (CX), Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Payments, and Financial Operations organizations to build scalable systems and operational tooling that support millions of users and transactions globally. What You’ll Do Design thoughtful, intuitive experiences for Topps, Fanatics Live, and Fanatics Collect across web and mobile products. Translate product requirements, user needs, and business objectives into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs. Contribute to the design process from early exploration and concept development through detailed design and implementation. Work closely with product managers and engineers to understand requirements, explore solutions, and bring experiences to life. Partner with other designers to understand user problems and develop solutions within established product and design direction. Collaborate with our Graphic Designer and creative partners to ensure product experiences feel connected to the visual identity and expression of each brand. Apply and contribute to established design systems, patterns, and interaction standards to create consistent experiences. Use feedback, research, product insights, and data to iterate on designs and improve the user experience. Create prototypes and other design artifacts that help communicate ideas and facilitate collaboration. Participate in design critiques, brainstorming sessions, product reviews, and cross-functional working sessions. Partner with engineering during implementation to help ensure the quality and intent of the design carries through to the final experience. Manage assigned projects and priorities while communicating progress, questions, and potential challenges. Stay curious about emerging patterns and trends across product design, mobile experiences, social platforms, marketplaces, live commerce, sports, and collecting. What We’re Looking For Experience in product design, UX/UI design, interaction design, or a related digital design discipline through professional work, internships, freelance projects, or other relevant experience. A portfolio demonstrating your product design process and ability to solve user experience and interface design problems. Strong foundations in visual and interaction design, including layout, typography, hierarchy, usability, and responsive design. Familiarity with designing digital experiences for web and/or mobile applications. Proficiency with Figma or similar product design and prototyping tools. An understanding of user-centered design principles and an interest in developing deeper product design expertise. Ability to take a defined problem or set of requirements and explore thoughtful design solutions. Strong attention to detail and an openness to feedback and iteration. Ability to communicate design ideas and explain the thinking behind your decisions. A collaborative approach and enthusiasm for working closely with product, engineering, design, and creative partners. Ability to balance multiple assignments and priorities in a fast-moving environment. Curiosity and a desire to continue learning and developing your craft. Interest in sports, collectibles, entertainment, community, live commerce, or digital marketplaces is a plus. How You’ll Work With the Creative Team Great fan experiences require both strong products and strong brands. In this role, you’ll work closely with designers and creative partners to help connect the two. As a Product Designer , you’ll focus primarily on how digital experiences work—understanding user needs, defining flows and interactions, designing interfaces, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to bring those experiences to life. You’ll partner with our Graphic Designer , who helps shape how our brands and campaigns visually come to life across marketing, content, and other fan-facing touchpoints. Together, you’ll help create experiences that are intuitive, visually compelling, and distinctly Fanatics. Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the user experience across our web and mobile products. This is not a role where you receive a spec and produce screens. We want someone who asks why, reasons from first principles about what users actually need, and proposes the right solution, even when it isn't the one we asked for. Responsibilities - Own end-to-end product design for web and mobile: discovery, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished UI. - Frame problems before solving them. jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionText: About the role: Curri is seeking a Brand Designer to help the company look as good as it works. The design team is small and covers brand, web, design systems, marketing, events, video, and animation, so good work regularly gets pushed for lack of capacity. This person will own a large share of the brand touchpoints people see most, including sales decks, social, ads, and events. They will also build the templates and asset library that let sales and marketing move faster. Success means shipping strong work quickly while helping define where a still-forming brand goes next. What you will do: - Own the design of marketing and sales assets, including decks, one-pagers, case studies, social, paid ads, email, and blog imagery, and push each one past “on-brand” to genuinely good. - Build templates and tools that let sales and marketing produce polished work on their own without waiting on design. - Create motion work, including animated social posts, web animations, and video graphics, and contribute to Curri’s in-house video production. - Expand the visual asset library with new illustration and imagery directions that move the brand forward. - Design event and merch experiences, from booth graphics and signage to swag people actually want to keep. - Keep the brand system, files, and documentation organized so the whole team can find what they need and move faster. What you need to have: - 2–3 years of brand, marketing, or visual design experience, in-house or at an agency, with a portfolio of work that actually shipped rather than concepts and mockups. - Strong fundamentals in typography, color, layout, and hierarchy, so the work looks finished and reflects a clear eye for what is good and current. - Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), plus hands-on motion experience in After Effects, Figma Motion, Rive, or similar tools. - Curiosity about new tools, including Midjourney and other AI image generators, along with a clear point of view on when to use them, when not to, and how to refine what they produce. - Range and speed with judgment: the ability to move between print, digital, and motion in the same day, handle multiple requests without quality slipping, take feedback openly, and explain design decisions clearly to non-designers. Bonus points for: - A portfolio that shows brand system work and walks through your process, not just one-off pieces. - Templates or tools you built that non-designers actually adopted. - Experience making a “boring” or unglamorous category look good, and real excitement about doing it again. - A background in design-forward B2B SaaS, logistics, or construction tech. What is in it for you? - A real hand in building Curri’s brand while it is still being defined, with work that ships fast and gets seen by customers and drivers online and at events. - Range across print, digital, motion, AI tools, and merch, with plenty of reps early in your career. - Regular mentorship and feedback from senior designers who care about craft, and a clear path to Brand Designer II. - Competitive salary, equity compensation, and comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401K). - Hybrid role based out of our Ventura, CA office, working closely with the core design team. - A high-growth, mission-driven environment where your work has direct and measurable impact. Who are we? We are Curri, and our mission is to build the network and software that move the world’s goods with speed, intelligence, and trust. Curri provides on-demand, last-mile logistics for construction and adjacent industries with our nationwide fleet of cars, trucks, and flatbeds. Founded in 2018 and part of the YC S19 Batch, we’re solving the massive inefficiencies that exist in the construction industry. Our headquarters are in Ventura, CA. Learn more at curri.com http://curri.com. Curri is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.descriptionText: OUR MISSION Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. ABOUT BRAIN CO. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. WHY NOW Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a passionate and experienced Product Designer. You will play a critical role in shaping both the visual and structural design of complex, AI-driven software products. Your contributions will directly influence the company’s trajectory and the success of our innovative product suite. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead end-to-end design efforts, including UX research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and testing. - Experiment with new AI design tools like Lovable, v0, and more to define how Product Design’s function on product teams is changing. - Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to understand user requirements and translate them into elegant, intuitive solutions. - Design sophisticated software experiences tailored for enterprise and governmental environments, prioritizing usability, scalability, and aesthetics. - Help establish and evolve the design system and guidelines to ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across all products. - Advocate for the user, continuously seeking insights and data to iterate and refine our product experiences. QUALIFICATIONS - 10+ years of professional experience in software product design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating elegant solutions for complex enterprise software. - Proven experience designing visually appealing, workflow-oriented products that significantly improve user productivity. - Exceptional skills in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, etc.) and familiarity with prototyping tools (e.g., Rive, Framer). - Strong understanding of UX principles, design thinking, and accessibility standards. - Experience working collaboratively in fast-paced, agile, and multidisciplinary teams. - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions and rationale. - Prior experience in AI-driven or data-intensive software solutions is a significant plus. At Brain Co., we believe in transparent, data-driven compensation that attracts and retains top talent. Our compensation framework is built on market research from leading platforms including Pave and Carta, ensuring our offers are competitive and equitable across all roles. We regularly benchmark our compensation packages against technology companies to maintain our position as an employer of choice. COMPENSATION We pay competitively for every role and back that with meaningful equity, because we want the people building Brain Co. to genuinely share in what we build together. Beyond salary and equity, we invest in country-specific benefits because we want our team to feel taken care of, not only compensated. The annual base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $310,000. We publish this range for every role, as a matter of policy regardless of whether local law requires it. Actual pay will depend on skills, scope, and experience.

jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT ASSEMBLED Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved. Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments. More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled https://www.assembled.com/customers. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. THE ROLE We're looking for a Brand Designer who builds brands that stop people mid-scroll and keep them consistent across every touchpoint, from a conference booth to an email send. As a key creative hire on our Marketing team, you'll own the visual and brand identity for a company in the middle of a meaningful repositioning. You won't be starting from zero, but you'll have real latitude to evolve what exists and raise the bar. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of brand strategy and hands-on craft. You'll build design systems that are AI-native from the ground up: structured so repeatable work can be automated, delegated to agents, or executed by teammates without your direct involvement. That's not about doing less. It's about freeing yourself up for the creative challenges worth your full attention. We're in-person 5 days a week from our bright, airy offices in the Mission (San Francisco) and Chelsea Market (New York). WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own Assembled's visual identity within the marketing context: brand system, design language, typography, color, motion, and everything in between - Design and art-direct core marketing materials: website, email campaigns, event assets, ads, swag, sales collateral, and more - Build AI-native design systems, including templates, design files, component libraries, and guidelines that AI tools and teammates can execute from reliably - Automate repeatable production tasks (asset resizing, templated collateral, social variants, email layouts) so your time stays focused on higher-order creative work - Translate positioning and messaging into creative that resonates with CX and support leaders who are skeptical of hype and respond to clarity - Lead creative on campaigns, product launches, and events from concept through execution - Set the creative bar and manage relationships with designers, contractors, and agency partners WHAT YOU BRING - 5 to 8 years of brand design or creative direction experience at a high-growth startup or at an agency working with B2B tech clients - A portfolio showing range: opinionated brand work and practical, conversion-driven marketing assets - A genuine AI adopter mindset: you've integrated AI tools into your workflow, you know where they accelerate your work, and you're actively exploring what's next - Strong strategic instincts and the ability to translate ambiguous inputs into clear creative direction - Proficiency with the full Adobe and Figma suite; motion/video experience is a plus - Experience building and documenting design systems that hold up under real-world team usage - High ownership orientation: you move fast, make judgment calls, and know when to ask for alignment versus just shipping - Collaborative by default: you take feedback well, give it generously, and bring stakeholders along without designing by committee OUR U.S. BENEFITS - Generous medical, dental, and vision benefits - Paid company holidays, sick time, and unlimited time off - Monthly credits to spend on each: professional development, general wellness, Assembled customers, and commuting - Paid parental leave - Catered lunches every day (M-F) and fully stocked kitchen - 401(k) plan enrollment The estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $190,000 per year. The base pay offered may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options are provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong and has the opportunity to do their best work. We look forward to hearing from you! For United States Applicants: Assembled participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. For United Kingdom Applicants: Assembled is required to verify your right to work in the UK and will conduct a Right to Work check prior to employment in accordance with applicable law.

and company adoption Mentor other designers, and frame problems clearly enough that others can own them Prototype and test ideas quickly with Claude Code and other AI tools Minimum qualifications A Claude Code, and a habit of learning new tools to push what's possible Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience driving alignment across product, engineering, and data science product-led growth, from a single user to a team to a company-wide rollout Experience mentoring designers or shaping a design practice Comfort querying data yourself with SQL or a similar tool Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS) Experience defining AI-powered workflows for yourself or your team A clear point of view on when a product should ask for attention, and when it should stay out of the way Passion for building safe, beneficial AI that helps people do their best work Representative projects Diagnose why some people make a product part of their daily work and others drift away, then lead the changes that close the gap Redesign a core part of the product so people return to it more often and get more value each time Set the vision for a product's But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://aiosmedical.notion.site BEING A WEB DESIGNER AT AIOS We’re building a world-class team. As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results. Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life. You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanhlwu/, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-m-33b79642/, our CRO Lead. You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright/). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends. This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast. - Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks. - High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time. - Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land. - Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy. - Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer. - AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand. - Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high. - Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does. NEED TO HAVE - Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals. - User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision. - Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land. - Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential. - AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further. - Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it. - Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week. - Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed. NICE TO HAVE - CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests. - Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next. - Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints. - Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries. - Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale. - Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages. - SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed. OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: 1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. 2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. 3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. 4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. 5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. 6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. 7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. 8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. 9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." COMPENSATION & BENEFITS You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. - Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity BENEFITS The stuff below is cool as well. - Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate). - Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely. - Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching. - Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps. - GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s. - Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy. - Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm. - Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed. - What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture. HOW TO APPLY Apply via Ashby https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aios/497f94b5-e527-40ae-901b-ec8745903a7a and be sure to include: - your resume and portfolio - 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion - a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

jobs.title: Design engineer (US)
jobs.descriptionText: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product. This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design. We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do - Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it - Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship - Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive - Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook - Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component - Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization - Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards ⭐️ What you need - 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features - Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance - Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation - A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work - Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team - Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in - A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own 🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees) - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. Under the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. By submitting your application on the application page, you acknowledge and agree to WRITER's Global Candidate Privacy Notice https://writer.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/.

jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT CLERK Clerk is on a mission to solve user management once and for all. Today, we provide developers with full-stack React components and hooks like https://clerk.dev/components/sign-up, https://clerk.dev/components/sign-in, https://clerk.dev/components/user-profile, useUser https://clerk.com/docs/references/react/use-user, and useOrganization https://clerk.com/docs/references/react/use-organization. These APIs allow developers to build hard-to-get-right user and organization management flows. We believe that a component is worth a thousand APIs https://youtube.com/watch?v=enUuBY3HXh4. Our Dashboard is a primary tool for configuring our components, as well as a centralized place for managing your app’s users. WHAT YOU WILL DO You’ll join Visual Designers, UI Engineers, and fellow Product Designers on the Clerk Design team to own and uplevel the Clerk brand. You’ll optimize for customer delight, flexibility, and ease-of-use within a complicated, technical domain. We will expect you to: - Uplevel the Clerk brand. Lead creative direction and design to personally ship brand assets including brand identity, .com, product launches and more - Collaborate with a cross-disciplinary team. You’ll work with UI engineers, animators, product designers and more to create an elevated brand identity. - Bring innovative approaches to brand design. Use new approaches to bring digital experiences to life and create scalable tools that increase high quality brand output - Not settle for less than pixel-perfection. You’ll work with a world-class UI Engineering team to bring your Figma frames to life. You set the bar for quality. - Elevate our design culture. You’ll support and expand the Clerk Design visual language, asset library, brand design system, and design processes. WHO YOU ARE You’re a Senior(+) level Web Designer or Visual Designer with experience working in deverloper tools, AI or infra related brands. You love your craft. You push UI Engineers to build experiences they’re unsure if they’re capable of (and you expect them to do the same for you). - You’re in the Americas. The Clerk Design team is spread across the globe; Product Design currently spans UTC+1 to UTC+5:30. You live in a location that is ±3 hours within U.S. Mountain Time (MDT, UTC−06:00). - You have technical fluency. You have a deep understanding of designing interactive software on the web. You don’t need to author production-ready front-end code, but it’s a big plus if you can. - You work iteratively. Your process embodies a “ship and iterate” mentality. You value the quick pace of a growing startup like Clerk. - You own your time. You’re a self-starter who would rather find a tough problem to solve instead of waiting for a new task. To be successful at Clerk, you need to make the most of the autonomy you’re given. BENEFITS - Competitive Salary – We want you to know that we value the skills and experience you bring to the table. We go out of our way to make sure that you feel fairly compensated. - Equity Ownership – At Clerk, we believe in shared success. That's why we offer a stock option plan so that everyone can benefit from the growth and prosperity of the company. - Health Coverage – We care about your well-being. That's why we offer top-tier health insurance to ensure that your health needs are fully met. - Work Gear - Set up your ideal home office with the gear of your choice. At Clerk, we want to ensure that you have everything you need to perform at your best. - Flexible Vacation Policy – We believe in work-life balance and trust you to take the time you need. Although we recommend 25 days per year, our vacation policy is unlimited. This is in addition to observing national holidays specific to your country of residence. - Diverse and Inclusive Team – Join our exceptional, diverse, and globally distributed team at Clerk. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute their best in building impactful products and tools for the modern web.

But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. You'll own translating UX principles into polished, conversion-optimized designs at a pivotal moment as we determine the future of our digital presence. jobs.descriptionText: Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software. Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents. In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way. With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space. Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our ' How We Work' guide. As a Product Designer, you will… Design and prototype product experiences for Warp using Figma in close collaboration with Warp’s engineering, product, and growth teams. Iterate on existing features to improve ergonomics, cognitive load, workflow friction, design pattern consistency, and comprehension. Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution. Contribute to and help manage Warp’s design system and ensure implementation meets specification. Use Warp to ship UI nits, bugs, and modifications to production. Test designs with our internal team and developer community. Drive the product forward. You will be expected to operate as a product thinker as much as a designer. You may be a good fit if... You have 3+ years of experience working on AI, ML, DevTools, Data, or other technical products. You enjoy iterating and perfecting detailed workflows. You have a lived understanding of developers’ needs and want to improve their relationships with their tools. You're committed to building and facilitating relationships with non-designers to execute on your shared vision of building the best product for our users You have great communication skills, and have experience working with engineers on a technical product. You have experience contributing to or managing design systems. Bonus: Familiar with the developer experience Some basic experience with coding or using a terminal Experience at a fast paced startup environment Experience designing for AI tools Salary Transparency Warp operates from a place of high trust and transparency around compensation. When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider your skills, the level of experience you bring, and what similar jobs in the market pay, all while ensuring equal pay for equal work at Warp. The budgeted compensation amount for this role is targeted at $160,000 to $215,000 . Exact compensation will vary based on skills and experience. In addition to salary, all employees receive further compensation in the form of equity in the company. This is a meaningful stock option grant with a four-year vesting period and one-year cliff. Your equity is where most of the significant upside potential is. Comparing startup equity is always a bit tricky, so we’re happy to walk you through different valuation scenarios at the offer stage in order to help paint a clearer picture of the upside. jobs.title: Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT US Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language. Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages. Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana. ABOUT THE DESIGN TEAM We’re a small, high-craft team that sits at the intersection of research, invention, and product thinking. We build consumer and B2B experiences used by millions across 150+ markets — and a lot of the work is genuinely novel: inventing how someone talks to an AI tutor, what feedback feels like when you’re learning out loud, and how progress should be measured and celebrated. We stay close to learners through prototyping, interviews, betas, and experiments. We take craft seriously, iterate fast, and value a high-trust critique-and-build culture. We have something to prove — and we care about doing work that is both useful and genuinely excellent. ABOUT THIS ROLE We’re hiring a seasoned Designer to improve how design and engineering work together, starting with a world-class, agent-first design system. By agent-first, we mean the system is structured so humans and AI agents can make the same good decisions: choosing the right components, applying the right patterns, using consistent names, and reviewing UI against shared rules. This is a systems thinker, high-craft, high-collaboration role. You’ll work closely with dedicated engineers who will be your collaborators in bringing this to life across our product surfaces. You’ll own the design quality, semantics, and product usefulness of the system; engineering will own the technical architecture and implementation, with close collaboration on component APIs, constraints, and adoption. Scope - You’ll work across iOS, Android, and web. - We’re mobile-first in the near term, with an expectation that components and patterns translate cleanly to web as those surfaces expand. - This role focuses on product surfaces (not the marketing site). WHAT YOU’LL OWN - Design ↔ Engineering workflow improvements. Treat the seams between functions as a design problem: shared language, fewer re-made decisions, clearer handoffs, and faster shipping. - Component craft and system coherence. Set the quality bar for components and patterns, and pressure-test them by building and feeling the real thing (ideally prototyping with agents), not only speccing. - The semantic layer that scales. Component naming, usage rules, and decision guidance so the right choice is the easy choice for any designer, engineer, or agent. - Adoption across the design org. Create the standards and workflows that make using the design system the default, not something teams and agents have to seek out. - Documentation + QA workflows. Own usage documentation and quality check workflows that make quality as hands-off and reliable as possible, including AI-assisted checks for consistency, accessibility, and component usage. WHAT YOU’LL BUILD FIRST In your first months, you’ll likely: - Build and evolve the components we actually need — prioritizing the highest-leverage gaps, pressure-testing them in real product work, and turning repeated decisions into durable patterns. - Establish agent-first systems and workflows — rules + semantics that help humans and agents use the system correctly without depending on tribal knowledge. Set them up to show up in the right moments to create efficiency and consistency across teams. - Set the operating cadence with design and engineering — a contribution/review rhythm that keeps the system coherent and adopted. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in product design, with real depth in design systems built on tokens, component APIs, and a single source of truth in code (not only a Figma library). - You’ve helped build a design system before. You’ve contributed meaningfully to components/patterns/tokens, governance, adoption, and the messy realities of getting it used. - A systems thinker. You’d rather build the thing ten people use than ship one feature yourself. - Taste you can defend. You can pinpoint what’s off (spacing, motion, interaction states) and explain what’s right for Speak and why. - Clear communication + cross-functional drive. You can write the rule, not just draw the component, and work across teams to drive adoption. - Autonomy and end-to-end ownership. You thrive with little scaffolding and drive from problem → roadmap → shipped → adopted. - Fluency with AI in your craft. You’ve built repeatable ways of working with AI/agents and can explain what changed and why. - Accessibility and scale mindset. You think about how the system holds up as it grows across mobile and web. NICE TO HAVE - Comfort building or changing components in code (Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, or web). - Shipped consumer-scale mobile products across many markets/locales. - Built a design system engineers actually used — and that outlasted your time on the team. - A point of view on where design-to-code and agent workflows are heading, and what’s still broken. - Experience in language learning, education, or another domain where cross-cultural nuance shapes the product. WHY WORK AT SPEAK 1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company. 2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply. 3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel. 4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives. Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Solve for the customer: We serve multiple stakeholders – People looking for help from our Agents via chat & voice, CX managers using our tools to monitor and improve the process, and Developers looking to build on and extend our platform.
