jobs.title: Product Designer, Terminal
jobs.descriptionText: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Product Design team is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s brand and product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about. The Terminal design team crafts product experiences that empower users to configure and manage in person payments. This team transforms the intricate world of payments into intuitive solutions, letting users focus on growing their businesses. The team spans hardware and software, focusing on many types of users: end users who pay at the point of sale, cashiers and operations managers who set up and run the devices, and merchants who manage a fleet of devices and need to monitor performance. What you’ll do As a product designer, you’ll work closely with the product manager and engineering team to envision payments features in the Stripe Dashboard and our end-user-facing surfaces and partner with go-to-market teams to bring them to users. That includes new feature development, product quality improvements to our most frequently used workflows, and setting vision for our products to meet new user expectations in an increasingly data and AI-driven world. Responsibilities Understand user workflows and pain points, and produce, test, and iterate on high-quality designs to solve user needs Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, and strategy partners to define a north star and product experience for new features Prototype user experiences for user research testing and internal communication Collaborate with teams across Stripe to craft a seamless dashboard user experience Conduct user research to test design decisions before shipping Collaborate with our design systems teams to leverage and improve page templates and components Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Has 4+ years relevant design experience at a product-driven tech company Has strong craft demonstrated through a portfolio of work Has demonstrated skills in prototyping at a high fidelity Has experience collaborating closely with engineering teams Has excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through design deliverables, videos, and written artifacts Preferred qualifications Are excited about building collaborative relationships with many partners Are passionate for turning complexity into usable, beautiful experiences Are a strong design leader comfortable with bringing your point of view to a team

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: San Francisco · Full-time · In-person About Solidroad Building something great is addictive. It's like discovering your favorite TV show mid-season, except you're helping write the next episode. It's like unboxing a new gadget, except you're the one designing it. You shape how it feels, how it works, and how people react when they use it. At Solidroad we're solving a big, messy, exciting problem: how do you scale customer support without losing what makes humans amazing? Warmth, empathy, intuition. We're using AI, generative tech, and real-time simulations to make this happen. It's ambitious, difficult, and genuinely new. About the role We're looking for a senior designer who sees this role as more than just a job. It should feel like signing up for a job and a hobby. Or a job and a triathlon. Or a job and an advanced art course. You'll shape our design decisions, own major parts of our product experience, mentor your teammates, and push yourself in ways you might not expect. It'll stretch your skills and fill your life in a deeply rewarding way. You'll craft impactful designs (product interfaces, brand systems, marketing assets; it's all on the table), and make critical decisions about user experience, visual direction, and product feel. There will be challenging moments, but also regular moments of genuine "wow, we built that" pride. What you'll actually do day-to-day - Design the Complete Product Experience Stack Architect and build cohesive design systems spanning our entire product, from initial onboarding flows to complex AI interaction interfaces. You'll create designs that handle thousands of customer conversations daily, ensuring every touchpoint feels intentional, polished, and human. - Shape Brand Evolution Across All Touchpoints Own the visual evolution of our website, marketing assets, pitch decks, and product UI. You'll build scalable design systems that maintain consistency while knowing exactly when to surprise and delight users throughout their journey. - Drive Exceptional User Experience Standards Set the design standard for intuitive, beautiful interfaces that make AI feel approachable and powerful. You'll ensure our experiences handle complex multimodal interactions seamlessly, mentoring others to achieve the same standard of craft and attention to detail. Our Team & Culture We're a small, focused group working full-time in our San Francisco office. We're here five days a week because building something ambitious means collaborating closely, solving problems together, sharing ideas spontaneously, and occasionally challenging each other to padel matches, cold plunges, or karaoke evenings. We're intentional about creating a culture that's mature, supportive, and fun. You'll be joining experienced founders who've done this before, alongside a tight-knit team genuinely excited about building something impactful. We hope you - Have at least 4 years of design experience, ideally at a startup (Series A to C), where you've helped ship complex, customer-facing products that real people love using. - Bring strong design leadership, including experience mentoring other designers, leading design decisions, or owning significant product areas from concept to launch. - Have deep expertise in modern design tools, design systems, or AI/tech product design—bonus points if you've worked on notable or challenging projects we can explore together. The good, the bad, and the honest truth The highs here are incredibly high, direct collaboration with founders who've done this before, significant ownership, and a product you'll feel deeply proud of. The lows are that you'll need to move fast, navigate ambiguity, and sometimes tackle tough design problems solo. But the reality is that startups are a bit like a sport or an instrument: you invest in it not just because you have to, but because you genuinely want to be better tomorrow than you are today. If that sounds exciting, don't second-guess yourself. Get in touch. Send us something you've designed that you're proud of (portfolio, case studies, anything goes) and a short note about who you are and why this feels right to you. We value enthusiasm, ambition, and curiosity just as much as your design experience.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionText: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE Render's mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works. We're evolving from the go-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast-scaling teams. Our brand has to evolve with us. Developers already love Render for how it feels to use; now the brand needs to carry that same clarity and confidence everywhere else: on our site, in our campaigns, on a conference floor, and in every launch we put into the world. As Brand Designer, you'll be a core maker on the brand team. You'll take briefs and turn them into sharp, finished work across campaigns, launches, events, and everyday brand moments. You'll contribute ideas in concept development, own projects from first sketch to final files, and help keep the brand system consistent as it grows. You'll work closely with senior brand designers and creative leads, with plenty of room to take on bigger projects as you grow. What makes this work hard and interesting: developers are a famously skeptical audience. They can spot marketing gloss from a mile away, and they reward brands that are honest, specific, and a little bit delightful. Great brand work here has to earn attention from people who don't want to be sold to. That takes real craft and a good sense of what engineers find genuine. You'll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep collaboration with marketing, product, and engineering. You'll thrive here if you love making things, care deeply about the details, and want to grow your craft alongside people who will push you. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Create high-craft graphic design across the brand. Design key visuals, web and social assets, ads, presentations, print, and merch. Typography, layout, color, and composition are your everyday tools, and you'll bring care to every piece, no matter how small. - Contribute to concept development. Join brainstorms and creative explorations with a steady stream of ideas. You'll sketch directions, build out options, and help the team find the concept that best fits the brief, then refine it until it's ready to ship. - Design and extend campaigns. Working from a creative platform set with senior designers and marketing, you'll design campaign assets and adapt them across channels and formats. You'll keep the idea consistent from a homepage takeover to a social carousel to an email header. - Bring the brand to events. Design materials for conferences, meetups, and Render-hosted gatherings, including booth graphics, signage, print collateral, and swag. You'll manage production details with vendors so the work looks as good in person as it did on screen. - Own projects end to end. Take projects from brief to delivery with growing independence: clarify the ask, plan your time, share work early, take feedback well, and hand off clean, production-ready files. - Use and help evolve the brand system. Work fluently within our visual identity and guidelines, spot gaps, and contribute new templates, components, and assets that make on-brand work easier for everyone. - Grow your craft through critique. Present your work in weekly critiques, give thoughtful feedback to peers, and learn from senior designers as you take on larger and more ambiguous projects. - Collaborate across the company. Partner with marketing, product, and engineering on day-to-day requests and launches. You'll communicate clearly about timelines and tradeoffs and keep stakeholders in the loop. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4+ years of brand or graphic design experience, in-house, at an agency, or a mix of both. We care more about the quality of your work than your title. - Strong graphic design fundamentals. You have a sharp eye for typography, layout, color, and hierarchy, and your portfolio shows polished work that holds up across sizes and formats. - Experience contributing to concepts. You can show how you've helped shape an idea, not just execute one: the sketches, the explorations, and how your thinking moved the work forward. - Campaign and launch work. You've designed assets for campaigns or product launches across digital, social, and print, and you know how to keep an idea consistent across many formats. - Some event or physical design experience. You've designed for print production, signage, booths, or merch, and you understand what it takes to get files ready for the real world. - Comfort working within a brand system. You can work fluently inside an established identity and know when to stretch it thoughtfully. - Curiosity about developers. You don't need a technical background, but you're interested in how developers think and what kind of brand they trust. - Ownership and reliability. You manage your own projects, hit deadlines, and know when to ask for direction. You take feedback well and use it to make the work better. - Clear, collaborative communication. You can present your work, explain your choices, and work smoothly with marketing, product, and engineering partners. NICE-TO-HAVES - Animation and motion design. You can add motion to brand work, such as animated social posts, logo stings, or simple launch videos. Experience with After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, or Lottie is a plus. - Interactive design and experiences. You've designed interactive web moments, microsites, or playful experiments that invite people to engage. - Comfort near code. Some familiarity with HTML, CSS, or prototyping tools that help you test interactive ideas. - Experience at a developer tools or technical company. - Illustration or 3D skills that expand what the brand can do in-house. - Curiosity about AI-assisted design and how new tools can speed up exploration. - Side projects that show your craft and point of view. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. BENEFITS - 4 weeks of paid vacation. - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. - Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. - Continuous learning benefits & related support. This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization. Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you! jobs.descriptionText: Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ABOUT THE ROLE Quo is a product-led business, which means our product is the funnel. How someone signs up, what they do in their first ten minutes, and why they decide to upgrade are all design problems — and getting them right is one of the biggest levers we have. We’re looking for a growth product designer to take this head on. Working in close partnership with our Growth PM, you’ll design across the entire funnel — the moments where a curious visitor becomes a paying customer, and a paying customer becomes a bigger one. This is a role for someone who thinks commercially as naturally as they think visually, who’s comfortable living in data and experiment results, and who shows up as a genuine thought partner on what to build, not just how it should look. SOME OF THE THINGS YOU’LL DO: - Design Quo’s core growth surfaces end to end, from signup, onboarding, and activation to upgrade flows and in-product expansion moments - Partner closely with our Growth PM to help shape the roadmap, contributing your perspective on where the biggest opportunities sit and what’s worth testing next - Dig into funnel data and customer research to find friction, translating what you learn into impactful design solutions - Design and run experiments alongside Product and Engineering, treating each one as a way to learn rather than just a way to win - Balance commercial outcomes with customer experience, knowing that a short-term conversion lift that erodes the brand isn’t a win - Prototype concepts in code when it’s more effective than static mocks, using tools like Claude Code to validate ideas early and often - Contribute to the design system and help improve patterns that growth surfaces share with the rest of the product - Give and seek out feedback, participate in critiques, and help raise the quality and craft bar for the whole design team ABOUT YOU - 4+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio showing depth in growth, activation, and conversion work for PLG motions and self-serve products - Genuine commercial fluency, understanding funnels, activation metrics, retention, and pricing, and able to hold a real conversation about the business decision behind a design - Comfort working with quantitative data, from reading dashboards and analyzing funnel drop-off, to designing experiments and interpreting results honestly - Strong craft and attention to detail across user experience, interface, interaction, and visual design - Proven ability to partner closely with engineering, articulating the reasoning behind design decisions and navigating technical constraints early - Demonstrated understanding of the importance of keeping things simple, and ensuring that nothing gets in the way of the customer experience and value NICE TO HAVE: - Familiarity with experimentation tooling and analytics/data platforms - UX copywriting instincts, especially for conversion-oriented microcopy COMPENSATION The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: - SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $150,700 - $177,300 USD - All other US Locations: $135,700 - $159,600 USD - Canada: $140,700 - $165,500 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. WHO WE ARE We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. ABOUT THE ROLE Sales software was built for humans. We believe agents will do most sales work within the next two years. Reps already spend 4+ hours a day in Nooks across AI Dialer, AI Prospecting, AI Sequencing, and Agent Studio — and each of those grew up as its own product. We're hiring a staff product designer to turn them into one workspace, and to define what it looks like for a person and a team of agents to sell together. Nobody has designed this yet. You'll be the one to do it. This is an IC role, working closely with our head of design. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Set the design direction for the Agent Workspace. Define the interaction model, information architecture, and core patterns that unify our product lines. Make the calls other designers and engineers build against. - Design the human-agent loop. When should an agent act on its own, ask first, or hand work back? How does a rep review what agents did across 500 accounts overnight, fix what's wrong, and trust them more tomorrow? Turn model capabilities and failure modes into interfaces reps rely on all day. - Ship end to end, in code. Go from a customer problem to production. Prototype and build with real model output, ship front-end changes alongside engineers, sweat the details. Agree on the success metric with your PM and iterate until it moves. - Work directly with customers. Our biggest accounts have shared Slack channels with the team. You'll join calls, shadow reps during dial sessions, and watch how teams actually use what you shipped. - Raise the design bar across the company. Partner with our head of design to shape how a small team works: evolve the design system, run the hardest crits, raise the craft of the designers around you, and help us hire as the team grows. jobs.title: Langfuse - Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: WHY DESIGN AT LANGFUSE Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY - Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels. - Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast. - Simplifying complex workflows. Our users run evaluations across datasets, compare experiment results, manage prompt versions, and set up monitoring. You'll map these workflows, identify friction, and design flows that feel obvious in hindsight. - Collaborating directly with product engineers. You'll pair with engineers, whiteboard solutions together, and ship designs that work within our existing component system (shadcn/ui, Tailwind). You'll create reusable, consistent UI patterns that the whole team can build with. - Shipping design straight to code. jobs.descriptionText: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW The Product Design team at Benchling is committed to building user experiences that support the scientists who are solving the world’s most important problems. Our work has a direct impact on making scientific workflows more efficient while improving the quality of that research—ultimately helping to drive the biotech revolution. We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to help build Benchling’s small molecule solution, enabling scientists to discover and develop small molecules and hybrid modalities with the same power and collaboration Benchling brings to biologics. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for this critical product area, working cross-functionally with scientists, engineers, designers, and GTM teams to bring new capabilities to life. This role will also contribute to platform-level initiatives including new homepage and navigation features that tie into the day-to-day work of a chemist. An ideal person for this team will be able to balance customer needs and priorities with scalable, consistent, delightful user experiences in an agile environment. RESPONSIBILITIES - Work with Product Management and Engineering teams to define product strategy, scope, and prioritization in a startup-like environment - Work through product problems from definition and opportunity to shipping features to our customers - Design and prototype multiple ideas quickly to validate product directions - Own the design for high-impact initiatives from research through implementation QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of experience* driving the design of software products, ideally SaaS, while maintaining a relentless focus on the user - A strong portfolio of relevant design work that conveys an ability to ship successful products - A track record of working with and simplifying complex product architectures or workflows - Strong communication skills and ability to explain the reasoning behind complex decisions - Experience contributing to a design system for complex software products - Experience working with Product Management, Engineers, and fellow Designers in an agile environment - A background with lab work, scientific research, or healthcare will serve you well in this role—but it is not a requirement. * We've learned that people hesitate to apply without quantifiable years of experience. However, what’s most important to us is the kind of experiences you’ve had and the skills you’ve developed along the way, regardless of how long it took you to get there. Have well over 5 years of experience? That's great! Have fewer than 5 years, but feel you meet the other requirements? That's ok too! Please apply. HOW WE WORK We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #BI-Hybrid #LI-EN1 Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.descriptionText: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors. Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members. Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric air taxi. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org is building consumer software for people who love to fly: mobile apps, websites, and web apps for flyers, flight enthusiasts, and pilots. We haven't announced what we're building, and we're not going to spoil it in a job posting. What we can tell you: it's a consumer app with a large user base, and the design decisions made in the next year will define the next chapter of growth for the product. That's why we're hiring a UX Product Designer; specifically, someone who has shipped consumer apps that real people download, rate, and decide to keep or delete, and who can take a loosely defined problem and come back with something worth building. What You'll Do: End-to-end product design for consumer aviation apps on iOS and Android, along with the websites and web apps that support them Design for a wide range of users, from casual flyers and aviation enthusiasts to working pilots who need information that's fast, accurate, and trustworthy Run product explorations: sketch out directions, pressure-test them with users and the team, and kill the weak ones early You'll get context and constraints from Design Leadership, PM and engineering, but the design leadership on your projects is yours Ship to the App Store and Google Play, then keep refining based on how people actually use what you shipped: analytics, experiments, reviews, and user research Raise the bar on craft across the org, through your own work and through feedback on everyone else's What You Need: 5+ years of product design experience minimum. A track record of shipping features for consumer mobile apps on the App Store and Google Play, ideally at a startup, a big tech company, or both Products you've designed that are live and in users' hands. We will ask about them, in detail: what you decided, what you got wrong, what you'd change Deep fluency in native iOS and Android design (Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design) and strong systems thinking across mobile and web. You know when a pattern should be shared across platforms and when it shouldn't Experience using data to shape design decisions, from engagement and retention metrics to App Store feedback Comfort with ambiguity. If you need a fully scoped ticket before you can start, this won't be a fit A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just polished final screens Bonus Qualifications: You're a pilot, student pilot, plane spotter, or all-around aviation nerd. You'd be designing for people like you, and that matters Experience designing consumer apps built around real-time data, maps, or location Experience growing a consumer app: onboarding, retention, subscriptions, or monetization, social posting and marketing collateral Experience working alongside AI/ML teams, or designing products with AI-driven features You've shipped consumer products in a domain with real-world constraints (regulated industries, safety-adjacent, hardware-adjacent) and know how that shapes design About The Team: AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. You get the resources and momentum of a real org, but the product development startup culture of a smaller team based in the UK – building for an audience that genuinely cares about flying. If you want to hear more about what we're building before you apply, you can't. Apply, and we'll tell you plenty. jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT ANDROMEDA Andromeda is building autonomous surgical robots designed to help surgeons perform procedures more safely, consistently, and efficiently. Our engineers and designers work across robotics, software, hardware, machine learning, and clinical operations to bring robotic systems from concept to real-world deployment. We are a small, highly collaborative team of 11 that values ownership, curiosity, craft, and the ability to move quickly from idea to execution. THE ROLE We are looking for a creative UX Designer who thinks like an artist and is comfortable at the intersection of hardware and software. This is not a traditional product design role. You will design the experience through which surgeons control a surgical robot via an iPad, making complex real-time interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and human. Think of it like designing a game where every interaction has real consequences. If the surgeon pushes on tissue, the interface needs to respond visually, the way a game gives you feedback when you hit something. That level of craft and psychological thinking about interaction is what we are looking for. As the first and only designer on the team, you'll be hands-on with everything from research to pixel-level execution, without a dedicated research team, design system, or large budget to lean on. We're looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity to build something foundational, not a constraint. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design the touchscreen interface that lets surgeons control the robot intuitively in real time. - Create visual feedback systems that communicate robot state, tissue interaction, and surgical progress clearly and immediately. - Conduct user research with surgeons to understand their mental models, workflows, and pain points. - Rapidly prototype and iterate on interaction concepts, from rough sketches to high-fidelity mockups. - Work across both 2D and 3D, designing dynamic interfaces with animation and motion, not static screens. - Collaborate closely with hardware and software engineers to translate design intent into a working product. - Prepare and maintain design documentation to support regulatory and compliance processes (e.g. FDA filings). - Define and maintain design guidelines for the surgical interface. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3 to 4 years of experience in UX, interaction design, or a related creative field. - A strong portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, high-craft work. This is the main thing we evaluate, more than years of experience. - Experience designing something genuinely impressive, ideally involving hardware-software interaction. - Real ability across both 2D and 3D design, including dynamic interfaces, animation, and how interactions feel to the user. - Experience conducting user research. You should have done user research before and know how to translate insights into design decisions. - Comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment with limited resources, where the scope evolves and you're expected to move fast with what you have. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Background in game design or mobile game development. - Background at animation studios such as Pixar or Disney. - Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, or similar interactive tools. - iOS or mobile app design experience. - Background in industrial design, having designed physical hardware products (form, materials, ergonomics). - Experience working in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (medical device, aerospace, automotive), including preparing design documentation for regulatory purposes. WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - This is not a front-end coding role. We have a UI Engineer for that. - This is not a traditional enterprise UX role focused on wireframes and user flows. - This is not for someone who has only designed digital-only products. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Successful designers at Andromeda combine strong craft and taste with a deep curiosity about how people interact with complex systems. They prototype quickly, conduct real user research, and design interfaces that feel intuitive even when the underlying system is complex. They collaborate closely with engineers, iterate fast, and care about building something that works in the real world, even with limited resources. WHY JOIN ANDROMEDA? At Andromeda, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a small, highly technical team tackling some of the hardest problems in robotics, software, and healthcare. Your work will directly shape how surgeons interact with our robot, and will have a direct impact on products deployed in real clinical environments. WE OFFER - Competitive salary and equity package - Flexible healthcare benefits through an individual coverage reimbursement program - Monthly health and wellness stipend - 401(k) retirement plan - Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates - The opportunity to help build a category-defining company from an early stage

jobs.descriptionText: Ando is a messaging platform where AI agents can take on work alongside human. We’re rebuilding Slack from the ground up around two core ideas: durable memory and agents as first-class participants. While we are pushing the frontier, we still have classic messaging challenges to address. Ando has to feel faster, lighter, and more delightful than the tools people use today. The bar is high. People need to want to spend hours of their working lives in Ando, and then convince their teammates and friends to do the same. We’re looking for brand designers who are excited by that challenge, and who want to play a pivotal role in shaping our creative vision alongside our founder. About our brand & visual identity - Architecture is a form of art people are compelled to experience simply by living in a city. Slack and team messaging are similarly inevitable surfaces in our daily digital lives. Our goal is to build a digital platform where people feel at ease spending much of their day. - This company is named after Tadao Ando, a Japanese architect known for blending brutalism with light and glass. His work also captures a sense of peaceful silence (something we hope to achieve and use to differentiate from Slack), and his buildings often house Turrells, Kusamas, and more. jobs.title: Product Designer at AIOS Medical — Remote, $100-200k/yr inc equity
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://aiosmedical.notion.site BEING A PRODUCT DESIGNER AT AIOS We are building a world-class team. You’ll be taking on a senior, high-ownership role in product design at Aios Medical. We have multiple roles in the team across our clinical software and customer facing mobile app. You’ll be stepping into a product that has grown fast and needs stronger design leadership, judgment, and structure. Some of this work is visible and polished. Some of it is messy and internal. You’ll own projects end-to-end. That means taking loosely defined problems, talking to the right people, understanding workflows and constraints, and shipping solutions you can stand behind. We’re looking for someone who can run with a problem independently and be trusted to get it over the line. The work often sits at the intersection of user needs, business goals, and real constraints. You might be working with engineers on a customer app flow, untangling a complex internal workflow that’s slowing teams down, reviewing CX tickets to understand where users are breaking, or defending a design decision. You’ll report directly to our Head of Product Design (Ryan Wu https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanhlwu/) and work closely with our Head of Product (Ben Dowdle https://www.linkedin.com/in/bendowdle/). You’ll also work alongside the rest of our Product and Design org, as well as our engineering and CX teams. You’ll be superb at collaborating and moving fast. This is a full-time, remote role. We’re async-friendly and flexible with hours, but overlap with European and US time zones is expected. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Design ownership: You take ownership of design work across products and run projects independently, from problem definition to shipped solution. - Customer apps: You design and improve customer-facing web and mobile app experiences. Mobile app work is a major focus area. - Internal tools & workflows: You work on internal products used by clinical, ops, enrolment, and CX teams, focusing on workflow, usability, and efficiency. - Complex problem solving: You work on products with real commercial and regulatory constraints. You understand that not everything can be changed freely. - Business & user understanding: You start from the business problem and the user need. You can clearly explain what problem you were solving and why. - End-to-end project ownership: You lead projects independently, including discovery, talking to users or internal teams, defining the solution, and shipping it. - Clear communication: You can articulate your thinking, defend decisions, and hold your ground in discussions with strong opinions. - Hands-on leadership: You’re comfortable being senior, helping shape how design works, and supporting other designers as the team grows, without stepping away from hands-on work. NEED TO HAVE Experience: You’ve spent 3+ years designing digital products across web or mobile, including customer-facing mobile apps or internal tooling. What matters is that you’ve designed real products used by real people. Robust Portfolio: Your portfolio shows real product work that shows off your design taste. We want to see the problem, the rules you had to work within, and the impact of your decisions - including polished screens of the output. Ownership: You take loosely defined problems and run with them. You figure out what needs to be done, who to talk to, and how to move a project from idea to shipped solution. You don’t need constant direction, and you don’t get stuck in endless exploration. Craft: You care about clarity and usability more than surface-level polish. You can work within fixed requirements, technical limitations, and existing systems, and still make meaningful improvements. Clear thinking & communication: You can clearly explain what problem you were solving, why certain decisions were made, and what tradeoffs were involved. You’re comfortable defending your work and navigating discussions with strong opinions. NICE TO HAVE Formal or equivalent design training: You’ve studied design, computer science, or a related field - or you’ve built the same depth of thinking through real product work. Working in regulated and complex products: You don’t need experience in healthcare specifically. What matters is that you’ve worked on products where design decisions are shaped by regulation, compliance, legal requirements, or strong business rules. You understand that some copy, flows, or elements can’t simply be removed or redesigned, and that good design often means improving clarity and usability within those realities Design that gets built: You’re comfortable working with engineers and thinking through implementation details. You understand how design decisions show up in real code and systems. OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: 1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. 2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. 3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. 4. If we’re average we fail: We are only interested in “insanely great”, a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. 5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn’t say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. 6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. 7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud. 8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You’ll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. 9. Keep your head down: We’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 “You just build a fing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”* COMPENSATION & BENEFITS You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. - Compensation: $90,000-$150,000 (inc equity) BENEFITS The stuff below is cool as well. - Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate). - Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays) - Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching. - Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps. - GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s. - Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed. - What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture. HOW TO APPLY 1. Apply on Ashby https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Aios/781c4075-21bc-4c06-ba74-9c8f2a7a3cfc

jobs.title: Softgoods Product Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT 1X Weʼre building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but itʼs not. To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If youʼre inspired by this, youʼll thrive here. Weʼve been at this since 2014 and weʼre at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us. NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. Weʼre not demoing it - weʼre shipping it. Weʼre excited to meet you, if this excites you. If youʼve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. Weʼre scaling, weʼre hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all. ABOUT THE TEAM The Softgoods team is a group of makers, engineers, and designers united by a passion for creating products people love to touch, trust, and use. We bring together rigid and soft materials—textiles, elastomers, and foams—pairing traditional techniques with the exotic and unexpected, always with safety, a soft-touch experience, and a warm, welcoming feel at our core, carrying every product from first concept through prototyping to full mass production. YOUR CHARTER As a Product Design Engineer on the Softgoods team, you'll design the parts of NEO that people actually reach out and touch — the textiles, foams, and elastomers that turn a humanoid robot into something a family welcomes home. Owning these components end to end, you'll pair traditional softgoods craft with exotic, unexpected materials and carry them from first sketch through prototyping into full mass production. Working alongside industrial designers, materials scientists, and manufacturing engineers, you'll translate "soft-touch and welcoming" into repeatable parts that hold their quality at scale. KEY OUTCOMES - Own the full lifecycle of NEO's softgoods components (textiles, foams, elastomers) from concept through mass production, accountable for delivering parts at production quality and on schedule. - Deliver a soft-touch, welcoming tactile experience that holds at scale, accountable for components meeting defined feel and finish standards with a low defect rate across production runs. - Ensure all touch-facing softgoods meet safety and durability requirements, owning qualification so parts pass validation testing before launch. Owning testing & fixtures. - Drive design-for-manufacturability and cost targets, accountable for hitting per-unit cost goals and improving first-pass yield as parts move from prototype to mass production. - Qualify materials and manufacturing partners for new and exotic softgoods, responsible for bringing production-ready material solutions to the program. KEY COMPETENCIES - Softgoods design expertise — deep hands-on knowledge of textiles, foams, and elastomers, including yarns, dyes, knitting, and weaving, and the techniques that join them (cut-and-sew, bonding, lamination, molding), with the craft sensibility to make parts that look and feel premium. - CAD and FEA proficiency — fluent in 3D CAD modeling and surface design, and uses FEA to validate structural performance, durability, and fit early, reducing costly iteration once tooling is committed. - Design for manufacturing at scale — fluency in translating prototypes into repeatable, high-volume production, anticipating tolerance, fit, and process constraints early so quality holds from the first unit to the millionth. GD&T is a Plus. - Cross-functional collaboration — works fluidly with industrial designers, materials scientists, and manufacturing engineers, translating a subjective goal like "soft and welcoming" into shared, buildable specifications. - Hands-on maker — has personally built, assembled, and prototyped their own designs, bringing the shop-floor intuition to know what will actually work, fit, and assemble in production. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - Experience: 5-10 (Open to review candidates that shine with less) - Education: Bachelors of Science engineering or related, or equivalent experience - A portfolio is required, showcasing your professional work, personal projects, and passion projects. PREFERRED SKILLS - You take pride in doing things well and don't cut corners. - You love thinking outside the box and finding creative solutions. - You get excited blending tried-and-true methods with new technologies to solve problems the right way. WHAT DOES A SUCCESSFUL 1X TEAM MEMBER LOOK LIKE Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like itʼs the one thing you canʼt get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect. jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT US Tavus https://www.tavus.io/ is an AI research lab pioneering human computing. We’re building PALs: a new kind of application that closes the gap between people and machines, free from the friction of today’s systems. Our real-time human simulation models let machines see, hear, respond, and even look real—enabling meaningful, face-to-face conversations. PALs combine the emotional intelligence of humans with the reach and reliability of machines, making them capable, trusted agents available 24/7, in every language, on our terms. Imagine a therapist anyone can afford. A personal trainer that adapts to your schedule. A fleet of medical assistants that can give every patient the attention they need. With Tavus, individuals, enterprises, and developers can all build PALs to connect, understand, and act with empathy at scale. We’re a Series B company backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Scale Venture Partners. Be part of shaping a future where humans and machines truly understand each other. ABOUT THE POSITION As Brand & Product Designer, you will be the connective tissue between how the world perceives Tavus and how they experience it. Reporting to the Head of Design, you’ll join our design team to lead our market-facing visual identity while maintaining a strategic footprint within the product itself. We aren't looking for a production artist. We’re looking for a holistic thinker who understands that a user’s journey doesn't start at the login screen; it starts with the first frame of a video or the first pixel of a landing page. You will spend roughly 80% of your time pushing the boundaries of our brand: crafting high-fidelity web experiences, cinematic marketing assets, and narrative-driven campaigns. The remaining 20% will be spent embedded within the product team, smoothing the seams between marketing and product and ensuring user journeys are cohesive from first impressions through the user lifecycle. WHAT YOU’LL DO Champion the Brand: Lovingly and relentlessly evolve the soul and spirit of Tavus across our website, social presence, and sales collateral. You’ll ensure our identity feels as bold, cinematic, and innovative as the bleeding-edge AI technology we build. Bridge the gap: Act as the ethos bridge between Marketing and Product. You’ll ensure visual fluency and a seamless design language that carries the user’s experience from their first ad-click to their 100th persona deployment. Iterate on growth: Use your product mindset to optimize high-traffic marketing surfaces. You’ll drive conversion not just through "hacks," but through world-class design, crisp storytelling, and a deep understanding of the user’s psychological journey, from prospect to power-user. Embed within Product: Spend ~20% of your time integrated with the product team. You’ll contribute to our design system and take ownership of high-visibility product moments – onboarding flows, empty states, etc – that require an extra layer of brand magic and visual polish. Set the standard: Continually push the ceiling for what quality looks like at Tavus. You’ll move fast to ship campaigns while maintaining an impeccable bar for IA, messaging logic, and typography. You aren't just making assets. You are defining Tavus’ identity. BENEFITS & CULTURE When you join Tavus, you’re joining a diverse and supportive team. Our work is driven by our people, and our success is shared by all. This position has a flexible work schedule, unlimited PTO, competitive healthcare, and gear stipends, as well as plenty of fun. At the end of the day, we want Tavus to be a place for you to learn, directly drive impact, and work with a team you love. Tavus is growing fast, and we’d like you to grow with us. If you’re excited to get your hands dirty and help make machines more human, drop your resume and we’ll be in touch. We are not looking for cultural fits, we are looking for culture creators. Diversity is what drives our success – it’s at the core of how we hire, communicate, and work. We are inclusive to all and combine our diverse backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives to build the best experiences for our clients. To learn more about our team culture and benefits, check out our hiring page. https://www.tavus.io/careers

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Product Designer - FDPSD (US Remote)
jobs.descriptionText: FORWARD-DEPLOYED PRODUCT DESIGNER ABOUT TAILOR Tailor is a pioneer in Headless ERP technology. Our platform empowers companies to build internal workflows that adapt to their unique needs — faster, smarter, and developer-first. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Forward-Deployed Product Designer to lead product design for customer deployments and turn those learnings into reusable product patterns. This is a client-facing, high-context design role. You will work directly with customers to understand their operations, translate complex workflows into clear product experiences, and collaborate closely with forward-deployed engineers, product managers, and internal product teams to ship successful implementations. Beyond individual customer projects, you will also help Tailor compound its design knowledge: identifying recurring workflows, formalizing reusable UI patterns, and feeding project learnings back into our design system, component libraries, and product roadmap. WHAT YOU’LL DO LEAD PRODUCT DESIGN FOR CUSTOMER PROJECTS Work directly with customers to understand their business operations, user roles, workflows, pain points, and success criteria. Translate complex operational requirements into clear user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and product specifications. Own the design direction for customer-facing deployments, ensuring the final experience is intuitive, consistent, and aligned with the customer’s actual business process. Facilitate design reviews with customers and internal teams to drive clarity, alignment, and fast decision-making. BRIDGE CUSTOMERS, PRODUCT, AND ENGINEERING Partner closely with forward-deployed engineers and product managers to ensure that what is designed, built, and shipped is aligned. Help reduce ambiguity by turning customer conversations into actionable design decisions and implementation-ready requirements. Communicate tradeoffs clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Support onboarding, scoping, delivery, and iteration cycles with strong design judgment and customer empathy. BUILD REUSABLE DESIGN PATTERNS Identify recurring customer needs, workflows, screens, and interaction patterns across deployments. Contribute those learnings back into Tailor’s design system, UI libraries, templates, and internal implementation patterns. Help create repeatable design artifacts that make future deployments faster, more consistent, and higher quality. Improve internal handoff flows, requirement intake, design documentation, and customer communication patterns. SHAPE THE PRODUCT ROADMAP Distill recurring customer insights into strategic product themes and high-impact feature opportunities. Partner with product and engineering teams to prioritize improvements that advance Tailor’s platform vision. Use customer project learnings to help Tailor evolve from custom implementation patterns into scalable product capabilities. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 5+ YEARS OF PRODUCT DESIGN EXPERIENCE Strong experience designing software products, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, ERP, internal tools, operational systems, or developer platforms. Ability to design complex, workflow-heavy products used by multiple roles and stakeholders. Experience moving from ambiguous customer problems to clear product experiences and implementation-ready design specs. STRONG CUSTOMER-FACING DESIGN SKILLS Comfortable working directly with customers, facilitating discovery sessions, presenting design concepts, and incorporating feedback. Able to understand both business requirements and user needs, then translate them into practical product decisions. Strong communication skills — you can make complex workflows simple, visual, and actionable. SYSTEMS THINKING AND DESIGN CRAFT Organized, structured thinker who can reduce ambiguity and create clarity across teams. Strong understanding of design systems, reusable components, interaction patterns, and product consistency. Able to balance customer-specific needs with scalable product and platform patterns. TECHNICAL FLUENCY With the help of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), you are expected to produce working prototype, submit PR, collaborate effectively with engineers, understand implementation tradeoffs, and ask the right questions. Familiarity with APIs, data models, workflows, permissions, or configurable software platforms is a strong plus. LOCATION AND TRAVEL Based in the United States or within its timezone. Expected travel: approximately 10–20%. NICE TO HAVE Experience with ERP, internal tools, operational SaaS, supply chain, inventory, order management, finance, or commerce systems. Experience designing for low-code, no-code, composable, or developer-first platforms. Consulting, implementation, or customer onboarding experience. Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system or component library. Comfortable supporting multiple stakeholders and balancing competing priorities across customer delivery and internal product work. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary: $130,000 – $170,000 + bonus Benefits: Health, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more WHY TAILOR? You’ll work directly with the product team on a fast-growing platform solving real operational pain. If you love being the voice of the customer, reducing friction, and making teams more effective — let’s talk. Apply now and help us shape the future of Headless ERP

jobs.descriptionText: Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows. We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms. Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital. jobs.descriptionText: About the Team The Physical Engineering team sits within OpenAI’s Enterprise Verticals organization. We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products - shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish. We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with tools such as CAD, eCAD, CAE, and simulation software to support engineers from early concepts through design, validation, and preparation for production. We operate as a small founding team, working directly with customers and closely with research, product, data science, and forward-deployed engineering. We learn by building, putting products in users’ hands, and using their feedback to guide what comes next. About the Role We’re looking for a highly autonomous Product Designer to become the first dedicated designer on the Physical Engineering team. You’ll help define this product area from its earliest stages - shaping what we build, how it works, and how design operates within the team. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for someone with a founder’s mindset. You’ll work deeply with engineers and customers to understand complex technical workflows, identify valuable opportunities, and turn emerging AI capabilities into intuitive, trustworthy products. You’ll move between product strategy, interaction design, prototyping, research, and detailed execution, often making decisions with incomplete information. While your initial focus may be Physical Engineering, your work could extend across Enterprise Verticals as the design function grows. You’ll help establish reusable patterns and a high bar for craft across specialized AI products. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Define the product and design vision for AI-powered physical-engineering experiences. - Lead design from customer discovery and early prototyping through detailed execution, launch, and iteration. - Create intuitive interfaces that help engineers understand, inspect, and refine complex designs, simulations, and model outputs. - Work directly with mechanical, electrical, and other physical engineers to understand their tools, constraints, and workflows. - Partner closely with product, engineering, research, data science, and forward-deployed teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical products. - Prototype new interaction models for visual, spatial, and technically complex work. - Balance speed and exploration with a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, reliability, and user trust. - Establish foundational design patterns and practices that can scale across Physical Engineering and other enterprise verticals. - Operate independently, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and bring clarity to an exceptionally early and ambiguous product space. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have independently led substantial zero-to-one products from early exploration through launch. - Bring exceptional product judgment, interaction design, and visual craft to complex professional software. - Are highly autonomous and comfortable defining both the problem and the path forward. - Think and operate like a founder: learning quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and remaining accountable for outcomes. - Enjoy working directly with highly technical users and translating specialized workflows into clear product experiences. - Can move fluidly between long-term vision, systems thinking, rapid prototyping, and detailed execution. - Build alignment through compelling prototypes, clear narratives, and close cross-functional collaboration. - Are energized by unfamiliar domains and can develop enough technical depth to make thoughtful design decisions. - Want to help establish the design culture and foundations of a new team. Particularly relevant experience includes: - Designing CAD, CAE, eCAD, simulation, chip-design, manufacturing, or other engineering software. - Building interactive tools for visual, spatial, data-intensive, or technically complex workflows. - Designing professional or enterprise products that integrate with established tools and systems. - Working as a founding designer, early startup designer, or first designer within a new product area. - Designing AI-powered products and evaluating whether their outputs are understandable, useful, and reliable. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale. We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the experience for the developers and teams who build on LangChain. You'll work across our core product surfaces, and depending on where the need is greatest, that could include how developers get from first signup to real production usage, as well as deeper platform workflows like debugging, evaluation, and observability. The common thread is developers doing technical, often high-stakes work, and needing an interface that gets out of their way. You'll partner with engineering, product, and other designers to figure out where the friction is and design your way out of it. *This position will be onsite in San Francisco, CA WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build a deep understanding of how developers actually use LangChain's products through interviews and feedback sessions so your design decisions are grounded in real behavior and address user needs - Own the full design arc on your features — from early concepts to polished, shipped work - Work across a range of product areas and design initiatives as priorities shift - Collaborate closely with product, engineering and other key stakeholders to ship new features quickly WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 3+ years of fullstack product design experience ideally working on developer tools, AI, or complex SaaS products - Sharp eye for detail, with a strong foundation across user-centered design, interaction design, and visual craft - A track record of solving hard interaction design problems, particularly around dense technical data - Data-driven decision making - you are comfortable driving user research, both with internal stakeholders and external customers, and using what you learn to inform your designs - You take initiative and ownership of tasks end-to-end - Strong technical acumen - you collaborate effectively with engineers to design things that are both well-crafted and feasible - Start-up DNA - you thrive in fast-paced, highly dynamic environments COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. BENEFITS Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

We are a small but mighty team who are passionate about mental health. Role Summary Finch has unique design opportunities as it straddles the line between wellness and gaming, and our design challenges reflect that. We’re passionate about making self-care feel easy and fun for everyone, and strive to design playful, delightful experiences we hope users will love. If those sorts of creative challenges are interesting to you, read on! Key Responsibilities - Design playful & delightful flows, interactions, and high-fidelity visuals for mental health exercises, gaming mechanics, and growth loops. Prototype concrete solutions to ambiguous product challenges. - Create new design patterns that are intuitive and practical. Evolve our design system intentionally as we scale. - Design product concepts that balance product vision, speed, and business potential. - Work cross-functionally with engineering, product management, character design and character animation. Details for this location will be provided during the recruitment process.
