Read more about them here https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/61477f2c24a826836f969afe/685d83a71452245cc1129791_4d770abfd83e276ec15315a2e06945bd_Clay2025_OperatingPrinciples.pdf. - Read about us in the NYT https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/05/business/dealbook/clay-ai-marketing-fundraise.html, Forbes http://google.com/search?q=forbes+clay&rlz=1C5OZZY_enUS1155US1155&oq=forbes+clay&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOTIHCAEQABiABDIHCAIQABiABDIHCAMQABiABDIHCAQQABiABDIHCAUQABiABDIHCAYQABiABDIHCAcQABiABDIHCAgQABiABDIHCAkQABiABNIBBzkzM2owajSoAgOwAgHxBVAe8UAxJx_p&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8, First Round Review https://review.firstround.com/podcast/inside-clays-unconventional-path-to-1-25b/, and more https://www.clay.com/press. Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Clay-EI_IE9850794.11,15.htm page! PRODUCT DESIGN @ CLAY We believe that not enough design thinking has gone into the tools we use to build software. That means that most teams work across a clunky mix of tools and spreadsheets, stuck in monotonous cycles with lots of manual work. You will help us change that. As an early designer, you’ll get to apply a unique blend of design and product knowledge to re-imagine how working with data in Clay should, and could, feel. QUESTIONS WE'RE ASKING & EXPLORING - What are the best to deliver value to our customers and how could they impact our business? - How can we design a flexible architecture that scales across the features we need to develop to grow our business? - For example: how can we continue supporting people who want to configure individual enrichments, while also building out the infrastructure to run entire workflows automatically? - How can we onboard users around a specific use cases and then iteratively introduce them to new capabilities? - For example: if customers purchase a lower tier, how can we help them discover and understand how features in higher tiers might provide value? - How do we create abstractions and interfaces that are easy to understand for non-developers? - For example, how can we illustrate when actions in a workflow are happening in parallel vs. happening sequentially? - How do we let people move fluidly between the different parts of Clay’s product, creating a seamless experience that sparks delight? WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design & ship core features. Design and maintain core features and infrastructure. Given the size of the team, you will be working across the entire product and will have lots of responsibility. - Collaborate & learn. Partner with the rest of our team, communicate openly, give & receive thoughtful feedback, and learn from people who excel in their areas of expertise. - Take ownership. We're focused on building a high-trust, ownership focused environment where everyone aims to define what they think is most important to work on, and drive initiatives forward. - Interview users, analyze feedback, help prioritize the roadmap. Set up, run, and synthesize learnings from user research studies to help inform what use cases and improvements we should focus on. - Design & prototype novel interfaces. You'll rethink how we can make certain aspects of building software more intuitive to users, which requires you to deeply understand what building software looks like today. This could involve quickly building lightweight prototypes to explore novel interaction patterns that make building software efficient and intuitive. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Clear design process. You can identify the right problems to solve, consider multiple solutions, and speak intelligently about tradeoffs. You develop personal and shared processes in service of a shared higher-level goal, not just for the sake of having a process. - Excellent communication & collaboration. You’re able to consider different levels of abstraction so your ideas land with your audience. You default to visual communication, but also have excellent verbal and written communication skills. You’re organized and comfortable with both synchronous and asynchronous communication. - Systems thinking. You can break down complex problems and expose simple interfaces for accomplishing difficult tasks. You see patterns that repeat across the product and are able to abstract them into common interactions. For example, if we auto-fill the best values into certain fields in the product, how can we adapt the same functionality across contexts into the rest of the product? - Ability to deliver pixel-perfect designs. You care about coming back to something again and again until "it feels right", and you inspire your engineering partners to have the same level of care. - Thinking in interactions, not static screens. You embody the belief that software is not a set of static screens, but rather a responsive system that evolves over time. You deeply understand the nuances of designing for such a medium. - A customer-focused approach to design. You’re constantly empathizing with customers and checking back in to make sure we're delivering intuitive value. - 8+ years experience in a relevant role.

PRODUCT DESIGN @ CLAY Clay is at an inflection point — $100M+ ARR, Series D, and a rapidly expanding customer base. We're building a dedicated growth pod to systematically accelerate acquisition, activation, and retention. You'll be the design lead for that pod, helping us turn growth hypotheses into experiments, and experiments into durable product experiences. As a senior–staff growth designer, you'll operate in two modes: embedded partner within the growth pod, and trusted consultant to other teams who need to run their own growth experiments. You'll create quick wins through experimentation while simultaneously building the systems and patterns that make future experimentation faster, more consistent, and less dependent on bespoke design. QUESTIONS WE'RE ASKING & EXPLORING - How do we quickly gather quantitative data and qualitative signal to identify our biggest growth levers — and use those insights to decide how to act on them? - How can growth experiments ship quickly without creating long-term design debt or inconsistent surfaces? - How do we design growth surfaces (onboarding flows, carousels, empty states, upgrade prompts) as modular, configurable components — so running a new variant means changing content or parameters, not rebuilding from scratch? - How do we know when a growth solution has proven itself enough to become a shared pattern? What does it take for something to graduate from a one-off experiment into the design system? WHAT YOU'LL DO - Ship growth experiments. Partner with the growth PM and EM to design and deliver experiments across acquisition, activation, and retention — from quick A/B tests to larger feature bets — with a clear eye on measurable impact. - Drive evidence-informed prioritization. Design flexible, reusable patterns (onboarding carousels, contextual tooltips, empty states, upgrade prompts) that enable the team — and the broader org — to run experiments without requiring bespoke design each time. - Enable other teams as a growth consultant. Step outside the pod to advise other teams on high-leverage growth moments, providing frameworks, patterns, and design guidance so they can execute with confidence on their own. You can embed in a pod and step back to advise other teams. You're skilled at building alignment, influencing without authority, and helping others level up their design thinking. - Scalable systems mindset. You instinctively ask "how do we design this so the next experiment is easier?" You build patterns and frameworks, not just screens. - Clear design process. jobs.title: Product Designer, Product Platform
jobs.descriptionText: Who we are In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches. What you’ll do As Product Designer for Platform, you’ll define the experience architecture and critical cross-product systems that shape how Otter works as a unified platform. Your work will influence the foundations every product team builds on and some of the most important journeys across the customer lifecycle. You will: Define platform-level experience architecture across navigation, hierarchy, permissions, configuration, entitlements, and shared interaction patterns. Lead critical cross-product workflows such as onboarding, activation, setup, upsell, and expansion. Simplify complex, workflow-heavy tools by creating clear mental models, scalable interaction frameworks, and reusable product patterns. Partner deeply with Product and Engineering to align user experience with underlying system models, platform capabilities, and technical constraints. Work closely with the Design System team to translate shared product patterns into reusable, consistent UI foundations. Embrace new technologies and ways of working to prototype faster, iterate more effectively, and raise the quality of design outcomes. Explore how AI and new technologies can lower the barrier to complex software and shift experiences from “using tools” to “getting outcomes as a service,” with strong judgment about when to use them—and when not to. What we’re looking for 10+ years of product design experience, or equivalent seniority, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact product work. Strong systems thinking and information architecture skills, with experience designing workflow-heavy products or tools with meaningful complexity. Proven ability to define scalable experience models, frameworks, and patterns that work across multiple products, teams, or customer journeys. Excellent product judgment, including the ability to simplify complexity while balancing usability, flexibility, and technical constraints. Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders. Comfort working with complex system models, including permissions, configuration, object relationships, states, dependencies, and edge cases. Experience partnering closely with Design System teams and understanding the relationship between product architecture and reusable UI foundations. Adaptable and forward-looking in how design gets done, with meaningful use of emerging technologies such as AI, prototyping, and implementation tools to improve speed and quality. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and proactively identifying opportunities beyond a single feature or product area. B2B or enterprise experience is a plus, but not required; we care more about the complexity of the product and workflows they’ve designed. Why join us Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030. Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success. What else you need to know This role is based in our Los Angeles office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week. The base salary range for this role is $182,000 - $230,000 per year. Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus. Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees): Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options). Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term). Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity. Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children. Pet insurance discount. 401(k). Health Savings Account (HSA) Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter) Time Off policies: Discretionary vacation days 8 paid holidays per year Paid sick time Paid Bereavement leave Paid Parental Leave Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion. jobs.descriptionText: I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy. I started Anima to change that. Our mission is to maximise human wellbeing, delivered through personalised medicine. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes. This learning engine is the beating heart of Anima. We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~50 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions. Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them. If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives. -- Shun Base salary £110k-£140k, plus equity London, Farringdon At least two days a week in the office THE ROLE Design software that makes complex clinical work feel simple. You’ll own product problems from discovery through launch and beyond, working directly with customers and engineers. That could mean rethinking a workflow clinicians repeat hundreds of times a day, or taking a new product from its first idea to daily use. This is a hands-on IC role with real influence over what we build. We don’t have Product Managers: you’ll help decide which problems matter, make the product trade-offs and stay close to the details that make great software. You’ll also help shape our design standards and how we work as the team grows. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Get close to users. Join customer calls and visit GP practices to understand how care actually happens, where people struggle and what would make a difference. - Own problems end to end. Turn ambiguous needs into clear product decisions, test ideas and work with engineers to ship them. - Make complexity feel simple. Design intuitive workflows and polished interfaces for people making consequential decisions under pressure. - Keep improving after launch. Use customer feedback and product usage to understand what worked and where to go next. - Raise the standard. Develop reusable patterns, improve our design tools and help the team ship excellent work consistently. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Excellent design craft. A sharp eye for visual and interaction design, with care for the details that make software feel effortless. - Evidence of shipped work. Experience designing complex B2B software and improving it through real use, with clear examples of your contribution and its impact. - Strong product judgement. An instinct for what matters to users, backed by evidence and the ability to turn messy problems into simple, useful solutions. - Technical fluency. An understanding of how software is built, plus curiosity about using code, prototypes and AI tools to bring ideas to life. - High agency and drive. The resourcefulness to keep work moving through ambiguity and obstacles, taking responsibility for the outcome. - Thoughtful collaboration. Clear reasoning, openness to challenge and a willingness to change direction when someone has a better idea. WHAT WE OFFER Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with: - Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus public holidays, with flexible additional time off. - Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance, depending on geography. - Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay. - Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you. - Learning: £1,000 (US$1,300) annual budget for your development. - Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 (US$65) per month. - Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget. - Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico. - Farringdon office: for those in the UK, a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week. Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionText: Ambrook helps American family-run businesses become more profitable and resilient. From volatile markets to climate shifts, independent operators face mounting pressure. While sustainable investments often yield the best long-term returns, they require financial clarity and capital that fragmented legacy systems can’t provide. We are rebuilding the financial infrastructure that real economy operators rely on. By replacing paperwork with modern tools for accounting, banking, and spending, Ambrook gives owners the data they need to prove viability to lenders and the next generation. We empower the stewards of land and labor to make confident investments in their future. We’re a Series B startup backed by Lachy Groom, Thrive Capital, Dylan Field, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Cameron Ventures, and leaders at Notion, Gusto, and Vercel. We’re looking for team members to help us untangle the intersection of American industry, climate, and the economy. THE OPPORTUNITY A 1954 Census of Agriculture questionnaire hangs next to our creative director's desk. Well organized, carefully set, with a hand-drawn illustration of America. It's also just a form, made to be filled in and mailed back. Someone decided paperwork was worth that effort. That's the standard. What that gets you is a job shaped like this. - You'd share responsibility for where the brand goes. Working alongside our creative director. - You'd work across form factors. The standard issue: website, campaigns, lifecycle. And the oddities. We've made zines, newspapers, matchboxes, sweaters. If you can make the case for the impact, we'll make it. - You'd help work out what a brand team is when the work is partly automated. We're further along than most and we intend to show the way. Part of the job is building the tools that absorb your busywork, so your time goes to the work that actually needs you. - You'd have variety and no playbook. Most of what you make here won't have a precedent inside the company, so you'd be taking ideas from a sentence in a meeting to a finished thing. You'll report to Ali Aas, our Creative Director, inside the Brand team, working closely with Marketing, Product Design, and other cross-functional teams. YOU'LL OWN - Narrative and craft. The bar on both, across the work you're accountable for, including the work you direct rather than make. - Getting brand expressions made. Work goes out because you made it, directed a contractor, enabled a teammate, or built the agent that made it. However it happens, it's on you. - What the team can make without you. The skills, templates, and evals that let anyone at Ambrook produce work that represents the brand well. - Brand evolution. Working with the creative director to mature and advance the brand, one expression at a time. RESPONSIBILITIES - Shape the narrative. Work with the teams closest to the project to find the story, then make the copy, the imagery, and the composition serve it. - Show the team what's possible. Make the abstract tangible with a prototype, a mockup, a printed sample. People commit to things they can see. - Make the work. Website, email, editorial, merchandise, event experiences, microsites, brand moments inside the product, and whatever the next idea needs. We're a small team, so you'll have your hands in everything. - Work the way that scales. Some things you make once. Some things should be a template or a skill so nobody has to ask you next time. - Direct the people who make things. Brief our illustrator, photographers, printers, and fabricators, then judge what comes back. Some of the best work here is made by someone else and made right because of you. - Maintain our brand systems. Design libraries, Sanity components, and brand documentation only stay useful if someone tends them. ABOUT YOU - Mid-level to senior experience. 4+ years making brand work. - Craft. You fixate on the details nobody else notices but everybody feels. - You are a builder. You're happiest making things real, whether that's prototyping a microsite, proofing a zine on your home printer, or getting a page live in the CMS yourself. Whatever the work needs, you teach yourself and get good at it. - Range across physical and digital. As comfortable designing components for a marketing landing page as you are selecting a garment for company merch. - You've built with AI. Not demos. Workflows and tools that stayed in use, that you and your team reach for regularly. - Self-directed. Brand touches every team here, so you're used to gathering context from data and the people around you, turning the seed of an idea into a proposal, and keeping everyone on schedule without being asked. - Bonus: Motion experience, or enough scrappiness to figure it out with whatever tool gets there fastest. BENEFITS - Competitive salary - Health insurance - 401(k) with matching contribution - Paid parental leave - Flexible vacation time - Flexible work hours - Work-from-home/remote office stipend, or a desk at Ambrook's NYC, SF, or Denver office - Wellness stipend - Professional development stipend OUR VALUES - Reach Understanding. We are driven by curiosity and empathy to learn about our customers, team, and world. - Real Talk. We create space for ourselves and others to be straightforward, vulnerable, and accountable. - Be Proactively Resourceful. We are internally motivated and externally empowered to identify opportunities and solve problems. - Derisk Thoughtfully. We lean into the biggest risks we face as a company and put in the work to address them systematically. - Find the Positive-Sum. We believe in creating incentive structures that align the needs of our company, our customers, and our planet.

jobs.title: Web Designer, Growth at AIOS — Remote, $100k–$200k/yr inc equity
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21 BEING A WEB DESIGNER, GROWTH AT AIOS We are building a world-class team. As Web Designer, Growth at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn cold clicks into customers, designing the pages that take a stranger from an ad to a purchase. Visual polish matters, and for this role it comes second. Mastery here is conversion craft: knowing what goes on the first screen and in what order, turning a product into an offer, putting proof exactly where the doubt shows up, and removing risk at every step. You write and test your own headlines. You carry the ad’s promise and look all the way through to checkout. You’ll own pre-conversion across our brands: landing pages, advertorials and listicles, quiz-to-plan flows and checkout, for our GLP-1 business and for the new non-Rx products we’re launching. You’ll ship your own pages to production with AI tools, without waiting on a developer, and you’ll live with each funnel through round after round of tests until you know exactly what moves the number. You’ll: - Turn every growth bet into a live, high-converting page in days, not weeks - Close the gap between our funnels and best-in-class DTC, starting with the friction after our UK quiz - Launch new products with pages built to sell to cold traffic from day one - Keep us ahead of what’s new in DTC, and have our version live the same week Great performance in this role means our pages win on persuasion, not just polish, and every new product and market launches with a funnel designed to convert. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is an intense, hands-on IC role within the Growth team. You’ll report directly to our Head of Growth (David Charles https://www.linkedin.com/in/david-charles-mood/). You’ll also work most closely with: - CRO Lead (Michael McCann https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-m-33b79642/) - Head of Design (Ryan Wu https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanhlwu/) - Growth (Jake https://www.linkedin.com/in/jakeantifaev/) - CEO (Richie https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright/) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES You’ll own pre-conversion end to end, from the ad click to the purchase. - First screen and page order: Decide what goes on the first screen and in what order, so a cold visitor knows what this is, why it’s for them and what to do next within seconds. - Offer design: Turn a product into an offer: the plan, the price anchor, the value stack, bonuses and the guarantee. Plan cards, best-value picks, struck prices and gifts inside the selected plan are your tools, not afterthoughts. - Proof and risk reversal: Put proof where the doubt shows up, not in a reviews block at the bottom, and remove risk at each step: what happens next, who the doctor is, cancel anytime, when it arrives. - Headlines and copy: Write and test your own headlines rather than laying out copy someone else handed over, and explain why one beats another. - Carrying the scent: Carry the ad’s promise and look through to the page, working with the growth team so the creative and the landing page feel like one journey. - Presells and quiz funnels: Design and iterate advertorials, numbered listicles, story pages and our quiz-to-plan flow, including the results moment and a plan page that feels built for one person. - Engaging pages: Use native-looking media, UGC, motion and before-and-afters where compliance allows, so the page holds attention the way the ad did. - Ship and iterate: Ship your own pages to production with AI tools, then live with the funnel through many rounds of tests, cut what loses and double down on what wins. Recent examples in motion: the UK post-quiz back end, the DE listicle, and Wave 1 non-Rx launches (skin, hair, ED, non-clinical). - Stay ahead of DTC: Track new formats across ecommerce as they appear (like RYZE’s Instagram-story listicles) and bring the best of them to our funnels fast. NEED TO HAVE - Live pages with real spend: Your best work is URLs that ran behind paid traffic. You can share live pages, the brand, rough monthly spend and the result. - Direct response ecom at scale: You’ve designed pages that sold a product to cold traffic with real spend behind them. Lead gen, info products, brand sites and app UI don’t count on their own. - Test history on one funnel: You’ve spent real time on one funnel at scale, on staff or in a long engagement, and can walk through a series of tests: what won, what lost, by how much and what you’d try next. - Direct response taste: You can name brands outside telehealth that do this well and explain why. Your acquisition references are DTC brands, not Apple, Airbnb or Whoop. - Offer thinking: You talk about the plan, price presentation, bundles, guarantees and gifts as naturally as you talk about layout. - Copy: You’re proficient in DTC and direct response copy and write your own pages. You may not be an S-tier copywriter, but you’re at least solid, and always hungry to improve. - CRO: Hands-on experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests, and using the results to decide what to try next. - Ownership: You own the results your pages generate. You’re a leader who gives a sh*t, not just an internal services function. - Ship it yourself, fast with AI: You ship your own pages to production with AI tools, without waiting on a developer, and can have a new format live the same week you spot it. - Visual craft at our bar: Required, and checked last. Your pages are clean, fast and on-brand within our design system. ‼️ NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF: you’re an agency designer with no test history, an app or product designer, or your work is all corporate ecom, brand sites or Dribbble-style concepts with no conversion numbers. NICE TO HAVE - Quiz funnels: Experience designing long quizzes that build commitment and end on a personalised plan page. - Health and supplements: Experience on supplement, wellness or telehealth DTC pages, including compliant claims (FTC, ASA). - Analytics: Comfortable in behaviour and testing tools, and reading funnel data to find where people drop off. - Ad-to-funnel congruence: You understand carrying congruence from ad to funnel, and build accordingly. You think in awareness stages. - Motion and UGC: Able to cut native-looking video, motion and UGC assets for the page yourself. - Multi-market: Experience adapting funnels for different countries and languages. OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: 1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. 2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. 3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. 4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. 5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. 6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. 7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. 8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. 9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. 🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." COMPENSATION & BENEFITS You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. - Compensation: $100,000-$200,000/yr (inc equity) BENEFITS The stuff below is cool as well. - GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s - Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching - Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate) - Vacation: PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays) - Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely - Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching ($1200/yr) - Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps ($1200/yr) - Coaching: free biweekly health coaching - Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed - What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA. Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve. We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system. Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future. Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time. The Opportunity: We’re looking for an experienced and systems-oriented Product Designer to join our in-house design team. You will report to the Head of Product and play a foundational role in shaping how care is delivered, managed, and experienced across our platform. Abby Care is redefining family caregiving with AI-powered products and support. In this role, you’ll design end-to-end experiences across web and mobile for a wide range of users: family caregivers, clinicians, and operators. You’ll tackle complex, real-world problems and help shape the product direction and roadmap. This is a Full-Time Hybrid opportunity based in San Francisco. What you'll work on: - Own end-to-end product design: You will take full ownership of the design lifecycle, from problem framing and user research to workflows, interaction design, high-fidelity UI, launch, and iteration. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and accountability while being supported by the product and engineering teams. - Design systems and workflows, not just screens: You will design durable, configurable systems that support complex, multi-step workflows across roles and surfaces. This includes information architecture, role-based permissions, states, statuses, lifecycles, and edge cases. You should optimize for clarity, scalability, and correctness over visual flourish. - Design for multiple users and contexts: You will design experiences for a diverse set of users: family caregivers (B2C), as well as clinicians and operators (B2B), across both mobile and web. You’ll work with the product and engineering teams to balance differing needs, mental models, and constraints while maintaining coherence across the platform. - Partner cross-functionally to solve real-world problems: You will work closely with product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance teams to ensure solutions work in practice. You’ll help translate technical, regulatory, and operational constraints into thoughtful design decisions. - Design AI-assisted and human-in-the-loop experiences: You will contribute to the design of AI-assisted workflows that guide, support, and augment users while maintaining trust, transparency, and appropriate guardrails. What success looks like: - Build a durable design system and clear information architecture that empowers our product and engineering teams to build complex workflows quickly and correctly. - Delivered highly intuitive, cross-platform solutions that seamlessly support the distinct mental models and needs of family caregivers, clinicians, and operators within a single coherent platform. - Cross-functionally launch human-in-the-loop, AI-assisted features that safely augment users while navigating strict healthcare regulations. What you'll have: - 3+ years of professional experience as a product designer - Strong experience designing systems, workflows, and information architecture - Experience designing for multi-role, permissioned products - Experience across web and mobile - Comfort owning the full design process, including user research, synthesis, and iteration - Experience working in healthcare or other regulated, high-stakes industries is preferred - Experience at startups or on small, fast-moving teams is preferred Benefits: - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work. - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance. - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays. - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered). - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows. OUR VALUES 1. Families First Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?” 2. Urgency with Precision Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand. 3. Relentlessly Resourceful As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity. 4. Purpose with Positivity We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve. 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care. Equal Opportunity Employer Abby Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation during any portion of the application or hiring process, contact talent@abbycare.org. Abby Care considers qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment and conducts background checks consistent with applicable law, including the California, Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Philadelphia, and New York City Fair Chance laws. We are an E-Verify participating company. Automated Decision Tools Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. regional expert in conversational design, helping shape scalable delivery frameworks and best practices for international customers Manage multiple concurrent customer implementations while balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholder expectations Partner cross-functionally to define scope, track milestones, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution Translate customer business objectives stakeholders, empowering customers to independently design, build, and QA their own AI models Design and develop virtual agent solutions using flow-based, prompt-based, and hybrid architectures regional expertise and customer success across APAC Qualifications We Value Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders Demonstrated project management experience, including managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously Proven ability to independently own deliverables, timelines, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment 2+ years of experience in conversational design, conversational AI, bot development, or related fields Experience presenting complex solutions to enterprise customer stakeholders, including executive audiences Experience working directly with enterprise customers in implementation, consulting, or delivery roles Experience operating in global or international customer environments preferred Fluency in a second language strongly preferred Background in Linguistics preferred Experience with prompt engineering preferred Experience with Dialogflow CX preferred Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend Compensation at Cresta: Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. Total compensation includes Base + Bonus + Equity , along with a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email). jobs.descriptionText: Who We Are Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. About the Role Everything at Verkada begins with design. Every part of our product experience is carefully crafted to be simple, elegant, and powerful. As a Lead Product Designer, you will be responsible for delivering best-in-class web and mobile tools (user interface designs, interaction models, prototypes, etc.) in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work with product managers, designers, and engineers to design our software, from defining a product vision to tweaking pixels before each release. What You'll Do Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, and product managers in a highly agile development environment with quick ideation and prototyping. Build and foster a collaborative work environment. Run inspiring and formal brainstorming sessions with engineers, product, and other designers. Developing product strategies that deliver on customer needs and the company’s vision Build clear, concise and intuitive UX/UI with everything from low-fidelity wireframes to pixel perfect final designs. Mentoring junior designers, providing constructive feedback and elevating their work to the highest standards. Serve as a project lead, co-owning the final product with product and engineering leads. Manage multiple projects and stakeholder relationships. Manage and maintain a project’s scope and schedule. Initiate and participate in user research as needed on key projects. What You Bring 7+ years of product design or mobile product design experience Portfolio that demonstrates polished visual and interaction design skills Bachelor's degree in design, art, human-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent A drive to solve complex problems with simple and elegant solutions Proven experience in creative problem solving and partnering with product, engineering, and other designers to do so Experienced in creating and integrating animated visuals and interactive design Proficient in: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite US Employee Benefits Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. jobs.title: Senior Motion Designer
jobs.descriptionText: About Zipline Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. About You and The Role Zipline’s communications team shapes and shares the company’s story and impact. We develop and implement strategies and tactics to educate our target audiences about Zipline, tell stories that raise awareness about what we’re doing and the impact that we’re having, increase acceptance of and excitement for our system, and cultivate ambassadors. We are passionate storytellers and make complex topics simple and understandable. Zipline is expanding in the U.S. and will be delivering food, medicine, retail items and more directly to people’s homes in many states over the next few years. We are seeking a Senior Motion Designer to bring Zipline’s products, operations, people, and impact to life through animation and motion graphics. You will translate creative briefs, scripts, brand systems, and technical concepts into storyboards, style frames, animatics, and polished motion work. Your work will span social and brand video, product launches, explainers, events, web, and presentations. You will work closely with Communications, Brand, Social, Marketing, engineers, and operators, as well as a Video Producer, Cinematographer, and Editor. This is a hands-on role for a designer who combines strong visual fundamentals with animation craft and can make complex technology clear, accurate, and compelling. What You'll Do • Design and animate motion graphics for social and brand video, product launches, technical explainers, customer stories, events, web, and presentations. • Translate briefs, scripts, static designs, and technical information into storyboards, style frames, motion studies, animatics, and final animation. • Create clear visual explanations of Zipline’s products and operations using typography, maps, diagrams, data, product interfaces, callouts, and 2D and 3D animation. • Develop titles, lower thirds, transitions, end cards, graphic packages, and other motion elements that integrate cleanly with live-action footage. • Composite motion and visual effects into footage, including screen replacements, tracked graphics, masks, cleanup, and other shot-based work. • Collaborate with the Editor on timing, pacing, integration, renders, revisions, and delivery of motion assets within finished video. • Partner with the Video Producer to estimate effort, confirm requirements, plan reviews, and deliver work against production schedules. • Work with brand designers and creative partners to apply Zipline’s visual identity consistently in motion across channels and formats. • Collaborate with engineers, operators, and other subject-matter experts to represent products, interfaces, workflows, and operational details accurately. • Build and maintain reusable templates, animation components, title systems, project files, and documentation that improve consistency and production efficiency. • Adapt work across durations, aspect ratios, resolutions, placements, and regional versions while preserving visual quality and brand consistency. • Maintain organized source files, linked assets, naming conventions, version history, render settings, and archives for efficient collaboration and reuse. What You'll Bring • 6+ years of professional motion design experience in an in-house creative team, agency, studio, production company, or similarly demanding environment. • A strong reel and portfolio demonstrating motion craft, design judgment, visual storytelling, and range across 2D and 3D work, with your role identified for each project. • Expert proficiency in Adobe After Effects and strong working proficiency in Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma. • Professional experience with Cinema 4D, Blender, or another 3D package, including animation, lighting, rendering, and compositing workflows. • Strong fundamentals in typography, composition, color, hierarchy, timing, easing, rhythm, pacing, and animation principles. • Experience developing storyboards, style frames, motion tests, and animatics that clearly communicate an approach before production. • Experience integrating animation with live-action footage through compositing, tracking, masking, keying, and screen replacement. • Ability to translate complex products, systems, data, and technical concepts into clear and engaging visual communication. • Experience building reusable motion templates and maintaining organized, production-ready project files. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain design choices, incorporate feedback, and work effectively with creative and technical partners. • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments, versions, and deadlines in a fast-moving production environment. • Experience with robotics, autonomy, aviation, logistics, hardware, infrastructure, healthcare, or another technically complex field is a plus. • Experience with CAD-derived assets, product visualization, simulation, UI animation, data visualization, Lottie, Rive, Unreal Engine, or real-time workflows is a plus. • Familiarity with emerging animation, compositing, and AI-assisted creative tools is a plus. You’ll Thrive in the Role If: • You are a hands-on maker who enjoys moving from early frames and motion tests through polished final animation. • You use motion to direct attention, explain how something works, and strengthen a story. • You are curious about complex technology and diligent about representing it accurately. • You collaborate well with producers, editors, designers, and technical subject-matter experts. • You respond constructively to feedback and can iterate while maintaining craft and consistency. • You care about organized files, reliable handoffs, and the production details that make creative work reusable. • You are passionate about Zipline’s mission, impact, and products. What Else You Need To Know Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT GALLATIN At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made, not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage. We're a Series A company, backed by a recent $50M raise to accelerate the future of defense logistics. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Brand Designer to produce the brand and content work behind Gallatin's product marketing and corporate brand, for audiences inside and outside the company. You'll create the graphics that explain our products to military decision-makers, the decks our teams carry into program offices, our presence at major defense conferences, and the gear our team wears. Early on, the work is hands-on and high-volume. Over time, more of it shifts to building templates and reviewing work others produce. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Market the Products - Produce OV-1s, concept-of-operations graphics, and system diagrams that show where Navigator, Phalanx, and Burrow fit in a mission. They must be accurate enough for military SMEs and clear enough for a general officer. - Create product marketing collateral: one-pagers, solution briefs, launch assets, and proposal graphics. - Keep product marketing tightly aligned with the corporate brand, so each product stands on its own and is still clearly Gallatin. Carry the Corporate Brand - Maintain and extend Gallatin's brand guidelines across web, proposals, events, and physical goods. - Deliver assets for high-stakes moments, such as funding announcements, major conferences, and customer briefings, working directly with the leadership team. - Design social content for contract wins, product milestones, hiring, and company news. - Produce conference booths, signage, swag, and merchandise, from concept through vendor QA and production-ready files. Build Systems Others Can Use - Build org-wide presentation templates, type and color systems, and a library of imagery, icons, and diagram components any team can use on its own. - Produce internal brand and content: all-hands materials, recruiting assets, and company announcements. - Turn repeatable production into templates and AI-assisted workflows. Run the Pipeline - Set up and run the intake and prioritization process for design requests. - Brief and critique external partners when work is outsourced, and own the quality of what they deliver. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - U.S. citizenship (required for work on defense programs) - 6+ years of brand or visual design experience, in-house or agency, including work you owned from brief through production - A portfolio that shows identity systems and templates other people used successfully, not just finished pieces - Strong visual and typographic craft, and the ability to explain your decisions to non-designers, in writing and in the room - A track record of owning ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work with minimal direction - Experience turning technical or complex information into clear diagrams and explanatory graphics - Fluency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, and PowerPoint or Google Slides - Production knowledge: print and large-format specs, color management, and files that printers and manufacturers don't have to fix - Judgment about which pieces deserve extra time and which need to be good and done, across a pipeline of mixed urgency - Willingness to travel occasionally for conferences, events, and customer meetings BONUS POINTS - Experience producing operational graphics for DoD or other government audiences - Background in defense, aerospace, or government technology - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design and production workflows - Illustration or 3D rendering of platforms, equipment, and environments in a consistent style - Motion design, or the ability to direct short-form video - Experience as a first or early design hire, with a clear view of what you'd do differently next time - Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field MISSION AND IDENTITY We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works. Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent, you'll fit in here. WHY GALLATIN? The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point. COMPENSATION Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401(k), unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment. Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_English_unformattedESQA508c.pdf.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: About Us Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. About the Team Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. About Fanatics Live Fanatics Live is out to redefine the e-commerce industry—a bold and ambitious mission. We’re driven to unite passionate communities with the products they obsess over and revolutionize the online shopping experience through content, community and commerce. We are a small team of experienced product leaders and operators building products from the ground up with the unique advantage of being backed by Fanatics ($31bn valuation) - the world's largest sports merchandiser, which includes 900 sports relationships, 90+ million reachable fans, and exclusive licensing deals with the MLB, NFL, and NBA. The opportunity before us is vast. Live stream shopping in China currently equates to 20% of e-commerce ($300bn annually) while in the US, live stream shopping is on trajectory to double from 2022 to 2025. The Team Our people are at the top of their game... or on their way to get there. They’re smart and kind and skilled in an extraordinary range of technologies, approaches, thinking and communicating. We believe in context, not control and and trust the team to do the best work possible to achieve our objectives. We are distributed across multiple countries and timezones and value communication, clarity and candour. We are comfortable with uncertainty and change, happy to get to grips with new business sectors, innovative business models and novel product concepts. We get our hands dirty, are brave in their decision making and own the work we do. Responsibilities and duties: “What you will do in the role day to day” As a Senior Product designer, you will combine helping launch some of their most important products for our business, along with helping us to further develop our awesome team of designers and our design quality. As a key member of the design team, you’ll be responsible for designing products that combine both utility and beauty across platforms. Work closely with our products and engineering teams to solve real business problems, deliver measurable value to both Fanatics and our awesome base of collectors and sellers. You’ll also help grow our culture, coach and inspire the new Fanatics design team, supporting our engineering and product teams while elevating the strategic role of design within the organization. As a senior product designer, you will Work in small, multi-disciplinary teams to create elegant product experience, craft intuitive, human-centric flows and experiences on Web, iOS, and Android. Develop high-fidelity prototypes and visuals, delivering pixel-perfect mockups and design specs. Manage design projects through the entire product lifecycle, overseeing multiple launches simultaneously. Contribute significantly to design system development, including component design and style libraries. Collaborate with product managers, engineering, and leadership to design and launch features, as well as iterate on existing ones. Exhibit meticulous attention to detail in engineering implementation, and the ability to integrate into QA processes to ensure high quality execution Participate in regular design critiques and brainstorming sessions. Partner closely with Product Managers to develop and refine product requirements, create solutions, and secure stakeholder buy-in. We'd love to hear from you if… We’re looking for people whon can go beyod just delivering UI work, and who can demonstrate product thinking, a growth mindset and initiative. We are in the game of delivering excellence and innovation to our customers. You’ll need to show us that You’ve got significant experience doing user research & designing products and services, working as part of a team with other designers and engineers You have an outstanding portfolio that shows a broad range of design work from responsive web based applications, consumer experiences, and mobile devices You can advocate and explain your work in an understandable way without jargon You know how to respond to feedback on your work and on your approach You can take your colleagues and your clients/stakeholders on a journey with you, so they buy into your approach and your design decisions You care about the integrity of your work, but can still balance user, business & technical needs and take calculated risks to get things done You have mastery of Figma You have knowledge of design systems fundamentals, and experience maintaining, contributing, or building them You have experience conducting customer research and usability tests and then turning these insights into beautifully designed products You have ability to work both autonomously as well as within a team while managing and contributing to multiple projects concurrently You can work autonomously, but know when to ask for help You care about your work, and are constantly looking for ways to improve the product If you’re worried that you don’t 100% tick all of these boxes, please speak to us anyway. We know the “perfect candidate” doesn’t exist and we love it when people bring their own perspectives and passions to Fanatics Live. We’ll encourage you to develop in areas you’re passionate about, and we will support you in exploring areas you’d like to grow in. Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at www.fanaticsinc.com/careers The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ Salary Range $110,000 — $140,000 USD By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here .

jobs.locationText: Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.descriptionText: About the Team Superette is DoorDash’s award-winning in-house creative studio—a multi-disciplinary collective built to inspire, lead, and deliver culture-shaping work across every channel and touchpoint. Made up of creative directors, art directors, copywriters, editorial writers, growth creatives and designers, we exist to infuse creativity into every corner of the business and elevate it as a true driver of growth. Our mission is to build a brand people actually care about—one that shows up meaningfully, solves problems, earns its place in culture, and creates work that hits hard and sticks. Our studio is stacked with some of the best talent in the game, and our ambition is simple: raise the bar with every brief. In 2024, we were named the #2 in-house studio by The One Show and The Drum, and celebrated by Cannes Lions, Fast Company, and more. About the Role We’re looking for a Design Lead who can bridge brand storytelling with growth-focused design inside Superette, the Creative Studio at DoorDash. Leading a small but mighty team of designers as a player/coach, you’ll develop work that both drives conversion in the short term and builds brand equity in the long term. You’ll be equally comfortable optimizing CRM and performance campaigns for measurable results as you are elevating DoorDash’s visual expression and design language. Partnering across Brand, Growth, and Marketing, you’ll deliver design that is strategically sharp, emotionally resonant, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll report to the Head of Design within Marketing, shaping how our studio integrates performance rigor with brand craft. Responsibilities: Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary design team, providing at least 2+ years of hands-on leadership experience. Deliver creative that balances brand storytelling with growth performance across CRM, lifecycle, paid media, and campaigns. Drive conversion-focused assets while ensuring alignment and maintaining consistency of visual identity with DoorDash’s brand standards and design language system. Collaborate with program managers, marketers, and copywriters to turn insights into impactful creative. Use data and insights to optimize creative while elevating emotional resonance and long-term equity. Identify and experiment with new formats, storytelling techniques, AI-powered workflows, and design systems that expand how DoorDash shows up across touchpoints. Champion AI adoption within the team by integrating tools that improve speed, scalability, and creative innovation. Stay ahead of industry trends in brand and growth design to evolve our creative impact. Qualifications: 8+ years of professional design experience spanning brand and growth marketing. 2+ years of leadership experience managing and mentoring design teams. Portfolio showcasing both brand-building work (campaigns, identity systems, storytelling) and growth-focused design (CRM, lifecycle, paid social, A/B testing). Hands-on expertise creating impactful content across web, email, ads, presentations, and campaign assets. Ability to articulate and defend strategic design decisions to senior stakeholders. Experience translating complex business concepts into clear, compelling visuals. Strong collaboration skills; thrives in fast-paced, cross-functional environments. Expertise with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (especially After Effects). Background in technology, media, or digital advertising is a plus. AI fluency - experience with adopting AI into creative processes Compensation The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now, as LLMs expand that scope again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other. As a Staff Visual Designer, you'll practice this build-first way of working with real autonomy: using AI-native tools and code to move from idea to shipped work quickly, and owning craft decisions end to end rather than checking each one against a brief. You'll join Studio Central, a net-new Product Design team sitting at the intersection of product, brand, and innovation. Studio Central is a global team within Studio, DoorDash's Product Design organization, supporting DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms. We own how brand shows up in the product experience, partnering closely with Marketing and Product teams to shape cohesive, high-quality work and to help define the foundations, vision, and future state of design across our portfolio. Our work spans major brand moments, merchandising, and the systems that connect it all. Studio Central's systems and standards are still being built, and everyone building here, regardless of level, has real input into what they become. You'll have full ownership over your own craft and projects, and a real voice in the standards, rituals, and craft bar the whole team ends up working from, not reacting to a framework someone else already finished, but helping shape it as it forms. We operate in a hybrid working model, 1-2 days out of one of our Design Hubs, the rest working from home.
