jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT BASE Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Design Intern to join our Creative team this spring/next summer and work across some of Base's fastest-moving channels: paid ads, brand campaigns, and the visual systems that hold it all together. You'll work alongside our designers and marketing team to produce creative that stops people mid-scroll, build scalable template systems in Figma, and help us learn what resonates with homeowners across the country. This isn't a "shadow someone and take notes" internship. You'll own real output from week one — designing work that ships to the market, building tools your teammates actually use, and shaping how Base shows up wherever people see us. If you're excited about the intersection of brand, performance, and craft, this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design creative on a weekly cadence across paid, brand, and campaign work, working within Base's brand system while pushing the work forward visually. - Build and maintain reusable Figma template systems that both the design and marketing teams can use to quickly spin up new variations without starting from scratch. - Conduct competitive research — studying what other brands (in energy, DTC, home services, and beyond) are running across channels — and bring back ideas worth testing. - Organize and build a library of our top-performing creative so the marketing team has a go-to resource for proven templates and formats. - Collaborate with designers and marketers to iterate on concepts based on performance data and creative instinct. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Strong visual design fundamentals — typography, color, layout, hierarchy — with a portfolio that shows range and taste. - Working proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and an understanding of how to build templates others can use without breaking. - Genuine curiosity about what makes design work — you pay attention to the creative around you and have opinions about it. - Ability to move quickly and manage your own time across multiple deliverables without losing quality. - Comfort giving and receiving direct feedback — our team iterates fast and ego slows things down. ABOUT THE TEAM The Creative team owns how Base looks, sounds, and feels. Brand campaigns, paid ads, photography, illustration, all of it. We’re five people who like each other a lot and take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The work is real — we’re building a consumer brand in an industry that’s never had one — and it ships fast. You’ll learn a ton, make things people actually see, and have FUN. Come build with us. Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive. OUR VALUES - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results. - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Product Design Intern
jobs.descriptionText: About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the Team Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about. What You'll Do As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Key responsibilities include: Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience. Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses. Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems. Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers. Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users. Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback. Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery. Who You Are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a design-related field, such as UX/UI, Interaction Design, Human Interface, Computer Science, HCI, or a related discipline. Some experience using computer programs to design, such as Figma/Canva. Demonstrated experience designing experiences and user flows. Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices. Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, form an understanding through independent research, and effectively work with a mentor and teammates. Are a self-motivated problem solver committed to personal growth. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Proven ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate work while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Ability to participate in a paid full-time internship between May–August, 2027. Preferred Qualifications (A bonus, not a requirement) Previous project, internship, or work experience in UX/UI design or related fields. Experience working with or conducting your own research, presenting results, and acting on those results. Experience with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, V0, or any others. Strong knowledge in design craft and visual design. Intent to return to the degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op.

jobs.descriptionText: JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 30 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, 2026 and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up. HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES. We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5. Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it. THE ROLE We’re looking for a product designer who thinks beyond aesthetics. Someone who is as passionate about crafting seamless user experiences as they are about beautiful interfaces. You care deeply about building, shipping, and iterating on real products, not just making polished mockups that never see the light of day. As a Product Designer on our mobile team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the Eight Sleep app, driving the design of engaging, intuitive, and seamless experiences that help users optimize their sleep and health. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, and Research & Development teams to craft high-quality, data-driven designs that balance aesthetics with usability. We don’t believe in rigid design silos. At many companies, product design is split into UX, UI, and other sub-disciplines. Here, it’s all in one. You should be an exceptional generalist who can move fluidly between information architecture, visual design, and interaction patterns, with an eye for both pixel perfection and real-world usability. As a key member of our small but growing design team, you'll have significant ownership over the app experience, ensuring that users can effortlessly track, understand, and optimize their sleep performance while maintaining long-term engagement with the Eight Sleep ecosystem. How you’ll contribute We are a mission-driven company, so passion for what we do and our mission is key. At a high level, the role encompasses three areas: - Design: You’ll sit at the intersection of Design and Product, playing a key role in the end-to-end design and evolution of the Eight Sleep app. Your responsibilities will encompass the full spectrum of product design, from information architecture and low-fidelity wireframes to high-fidelity mockups, and everything in-between. - Validate: You’ll conduct usability studies and user interviews to inform design work, and work closely with our in-house customer discovery squad. You’ll use data to inform the success or failure of the design. - Iterate: You’ll combine qualitative and quantitative customer insights to make design decisions that improve our app experience, reduce churn, and increase engagement. Some other details about the role: - You’ll work as part of an interdisciplinary team to deliver captivating user experiences that increase membership value and support hardware innovations - You’ll build, document, and organize the UI components of our design library and system to drive consistency across our app and the rest of the brand - You’ll align with Product and Brand stakeholders and clearly present design updates to C-suite leadership for feedback and approval - You’ll serve as the subject matter expert responsible for app design patterns and interactions - including researching and staying up-to-date on emerging mobile design trends and best practices - You’ll collaborate closely with the Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams to ship world class products and features What you need to succeed - 8+ years experience in UX and UI, with a strong portfolio including live mobile examples - You’ve shipped your designs to public users and have data that proves either success or failure - You are able to consider the technical implications of design decisions and have the ability to find the right balance between new user value and technical effort - You have experience coaching junior designers and collaborating closely with Product Managers and Engineers - You are obsessed with simplicity, have a high-quality bar for the aesthetics in your design - You thrive as an independent thinker and can manage the design process from end to end even in open-ended ambiguous environments - Able and flexible to iterate fast and often - You are confident in writing clear agendas and decks, and presenting design evolutions to C-Suite leadership - Your are open to occasional travel to other office locations (San Francisco, Milan, New York) to work with other teams in-person - You are excited about the opportunity to build a fast-growing brand into an iconic company - You have a Bachelor’s degree in a related design field or equivalent experience Bonus points for: - Having built iconic, consumer-facing mobile apps at small and mid-size tech startups (with the data & reviews to prove it) - Experience designing mobile apps for Android Why join Eight Sleep? Innovation in a culture of excellence Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness. Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards. Collaboration with exceptional talent Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment. Equitable compensation and continuous equity investment We extend equity participation to every full-time team member, recognizing and rewarding your direct contributions to our success. This includes periodic equity refreshments based on performance, ensuring that as Eight Sleep grows and succeeds, so do you – perfectly aligning your achievements with the broader triumphs of the company. Pay grows rapidly as you accumulate experience with Eight Sleep and translate it into concrete impact. Your own Pod - and other great benefits - Every Eight Sleep employee receives the very product that defines our mission: a Pod of their own. If you join us you’ll get your own Pod https://www.eightsleep.com/, along with*: - Full access to health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your dependents - Supplemental life insurance - Flexible PTO - Commuter benefits to ease your daily commute - Paid parental leave *List of benefits may vary depending on your location At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT POINTONE The most valuable knowledge in a firm is in how its people work, and almost none of it is written down. PointOne builds the record of that work, capturing what people do each day and turning it into data that AI can understand. More than 250 firms already rely on us, whether they use PointOne Time to turn the data into time entries, or PointOne Intelligence to understand their margin, profitability, and the ROI of their AI adoption. PointOne is building toward a future where firms run on the record of their own work. We're a Series A company backed by YC, 8VC, General Catalyst, and Bessemer, based in New York City and working in person. THE ROLE PointOne is looking for a multidisciplinary brand designer to define how we show up and build the creative engine behind our growth. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from concept to finished work: evolve our identity, design campaigns, create and edit video, and direct agencies and production partners. You will own PointOne’s visual expression across every major touchpoint, from a 15-second social video to a product launch, website page, event environment, customer film, or sales presentation. You will be both a maker and an art director, working closely with Growth, leadership, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. This is a hands-on brand, content and campaigns role, not a pure management or product design position. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Build and evolve the PointOne brand - Evolve our visual identity and translate it into a practical brand system that can grow with the company. - Own and maintain the brand kit, including typography, color, layout, illustration, photography, motion and video principles. - Create reusable templates and asset libraries that help the team move quickly while keeping every touchpoint unmistakably PointOne. Create content and campaigns - Turn business priorities, product launches, customer stories and industry insights into strong creative concepts. - Design and deliver assets across social, web, email, paid media, reports, case studies, presentations, sales collateral, events, partnerships and out-of-home campaigns. - Build a repeatable video engine, including short-form social content, product storytelling, customer interviews, event coverage and campaign films. - Storyboard, edit and animate content yourself when appropriate, and adapt larger productions into channel-specific assets that extend their value. Lead creative production - Plan and art-direct photo and video shoots, including briefs, references, storyboards and stakeholder alignment. - Select and manage agencies, production companies, photographers, editors, animators and freelance designers. - Own timelines, budgets, feedback and quality control across external productions. Operate as a creative partner - Partner with Growth to translate strategy into a focused, high-impact creative roadmap. - Work directly with executives, customers and subject-matter experts to find the human story inside complex ideas. - Prioritize competing requests, communicate tradeoffs and use campaign performance to improve the work without sacrificing craft or brand distinctiveness. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least three to five years of experience in multidisciplinary brand design, ideally in-house at a high-growth technology company or at an agency serving ambitious brands. - An exceptional portfolio spanning brand systems and finished campaigns, with meaningful strength in motion or video. - Strong art direction, typography, layout and editorial design skills, plus the ability to develop an original concept and execute it hands-on. - Advanced proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, including video-editing and motion-design tools such as Premiere Pro and After Effects. - Experience planning shoots and managing agencies, freelancers or production partners. - Excellent project management and communication skills, including the confidence to present creative thinking and incorporate feedback without losing the idea. - Comfort working at startup speed and moving between high-level creative direction and detailed production work. - Curiosity about AI-enabled creative tools and the judgment to use them thoughtfully rather than generically. You do not need experience in legal technology. You do need to be excited by the challenge of making a complex, traditionally conservative industry feel modern, human and culturally relevant. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, fintech, professional services or another trust-driven category. - Additional strength in illustration, photography, 3D, web design or lightweight web production. - Experience building creative operations or performance creative for a growing team. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - PointOne has a clear, distinctive visual system that is consistently applied across the company. - We publish high-quality, multi-format content on a reliable cadence, with video as a core capability rather than an occasional production. - Campaigns, customer stories and launches move from idea to market faster, with stronger creative quality and less ad hoc coordination. - Our brand earns attention in a crowded AI market while maintaining the clarity and credibility required to sell to leading law firms, and external partners operate as an effective extension of the team. HOW TO APPLY Please send your resume and portfolio, including two or three projects that explain the problem, your role, the thinking and the result. We would especially like to see one multi-channel brand system and one motion, video or larger production project. COMPENSATION The base salary range for this role is $85,000 to $120,000. Compensation within this range depends on experience and expertise, and a competitive equity component is included. BENEFITS Benefits include comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, meals in the office, regular team events, a wellness fund, and a learning fund. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY PointOne is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: PRODUCT DESIGNER $150k – $180k • meaningful equity ABOUT NOVIG Novig is building America's #1 sports prediction market. Our mission is to financialize and democratize sports trading - taking a closed system run by casinos and turning it into a fair, efficient, two-sided market where the power sits with users. With Novig recently becoming a CFTC-designated market — the fastest designation of its kind in US history— we're bringing the prediction market built for sports fans nationwide. We're backed by some of Silicon Valley's top investors — Pantera, Forerunner, Lux, NFX, Paul Graham, and Joe Montana — who have collectively invested over $100M behind this vision. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Product Designer at Novig to help craft the core experience of the best sports prediction market in the world. This is a high-ownership role with real scope, autonomy, and influence over the direction of the product. You'll work directly with the VP of Design, founder, and core product team, shaping the product end-to-end — from understanding users, concepting new product features, and helping frame product direction to shipping precise, polished interfaces. WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU WILL DO - You build what users love. You design experiences that feel intuitive, rewarding, and differentiated, deepening how fans engage with sports trading. - You make complexity feel simple. You turn sports markets, live data, and trading mechanics into clear, fast, and engaging product experiences. - You validate ideas fast. You rapidly concept, prototype, test, and iterate to produce the highest-impact solutions, pushing for the highest quality execution, thoughtful interaction design, and strong product thinking across every surface and flow. - You help evolve our system. You define, grow, and maintain our design system to keep our product cohesive as it grows. - You have 3–4+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows system-level thinking, strong attention to detail, and tangible business impact — backed by excellent visual and interaction design skills and deep Figma fluency. - You have a sharp instinct for user behavior and what makes products click, with strong product judgment grounded in real customer understanding. - You have a strong point of view on design systems — you think in components, tokens, and variants. - You're AI-forward, with a strong interest in actively integrating AI into design workflows. - You move quickly and adapt well in fast-paced environments, with a bias toward ownership and action, clear and thoughtful communication, and genuine curiosity about markets. - Bonus: you have experience in fintech, sports betting, trading, or other data-rich consumer products. WHY WORK HERE, IN THE WORDS OF THE PEOPLE WHO DO “I work with extremely stellar people, I own real systems, and decisions happen fast. No politics, no waiting for needless red tape. If something's broken, I fix it. If I build something good, it ships.” “The people! They're smart, thoughtful, fun to work with and passionate about their craft.” “I'm having the most fun I've had in my entire career.” If you want responsibility, trust, and the chance to help build the future of sports prediction markets - take your shot, we’d love to connect. NOT FOR EVERYONE - Our work is tied to live sports - that means potential nights, weekends, and pressure included. - If you need clear swim lanes, a heavy process, or someone to tell you what to do, this won’t be the right environment. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - $150k – $180k base, benchmarked at top-tier tech companies - Meaningful equity for every employee, regardless of role - 100% health premiums covered - 99% dental & vision covered - 401(k) with 4% company match - HSA + $1,080 annual company contribution - $50/monthly company contribution to employee transit - $27/day lunch stipend when working from our NYC office - $35/day dinner stipend when working from the NYC office after 6:30pm HOMEBASE Union Square, NYC

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionText: About Niural Niural is the AI-native platform that unifies payroll, compliance, HR, and financial operations into a single platform, enabling companies to hire, pay, and manage teams across 150+ countries with speed, accuracy, and intelligence. Backed by Marathon, M13, and Inspired Capital, Niural is redefining the future of work and intelligent finance. Why Niural? At Niural, brand is how complex financial infrastructure becomes approachable, trustworthy, and memorable. As a Graphic Designer, you'll shape how Niural looks, feels, and behaves across digital, social, product, events, and marketing. We're not looking for someone who simply makes things look good. We want a designer who can think creatively, tell stories visually, and make ideas move, while experimenting with new ways of creating as AI and technology reshape the creative process. About the Job You'll help bring our brand to life through both static and motion design. This is a hands-on creative role covering everything from campaign concepts and social content to brand assets, presentations, video, animation, and motion graphics. You'll bring a strong visual point of view and an eye for typography and composition, and you'll take ideas from concept through execution. You'll work closely with marketing, product, and creative teams to produce work that is distinctive, clear, and memorable. Responsibilities - Develop visual concepts and creative assets for marketing campaigns, social media, events, web, and digital experiences. - Create motion graphics, animations, transitions, and short-form video content. - Bring static brand concepts to life through motion and storytelling. - Design social content, digital ads, presentations, illustrations, infographics, and other brand materials. - Translate creative concepts into polished visual executions across multiple formats and platforms. - Help evolve and maintain a consistent visual identity across the brand. - Collaborate with marketing, product, and other teams to turn ideas and briefs into compelling creative. - Manage multiple projects and deadlines quickly and confidently. - Experiment with new visual styles, formats, tools, and emerging creative technologies. - Contribute ideas, not just executions, to campaigns and creative concepts. Requirements - 3+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, motion design, or a related creative role. - A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent graphic design and motion work. - Strong understanding of typography, composition, color, layout, hierarchy, and visual storytelling. - Experience creating motion graphics and animation for digital and social platforms. - Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, After Effects, Premiere Pro, or equivalent. - Ability to take a project from initial concept through final production. - Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger creative idea. - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a fast-moving team. - Curiosity about technology, AI, culture, and emerging creative trends. Bonus Points - Experience working with technology, SaaS, fintech, AI, or startup brands. - Experience creating short-form video for social media. - 3D experience (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar). - Illustration or strong visual storytelling skills. - Experience with generative AI and emerging creative tools. - Experience developing brand systems or visual identities. - A portfolio that shows personality, experimentation, and a strong creative point of view. What We Offer - Competitive salary package designed to reward your expertise and contributions. - Access to continuous learning and career advancement programs. - Opportunities for mentorship and coaching to help you grow in your career. - Supportive and collaborative work environment where ideas are valued, and teamwork is encouraged. - Complimentary snacks and lunch provided to keep you energized throughout the shift. - Latest MacBook Pro and a high-performance monitor will be provided to boost your productivity. - We've partnered with select universities in the US to provide "fast-track" admissions to star performers who may want to pursue their Master's in CS in the US. - High performers will be sponsored for L1 visas as well as immigrant visas (Green Card) to the US. Working Shift: Swing (2 PM- 10 PM)

jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.descriptionText: WHAT IS KALSHI? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. ROLE ROADMAP The web is one of the most important places Kalshi’s brand comes to life. As we grow, launch new products and partnerships, and show up around increasingly ambitious cultural moments, we need our web presence to move just as quickly and feel unmistakably Kalshi. This role will own Kalshi’s brand expression on the web. You’ll design everything from core brand and marketing pages to campaign launches, partnership pages, policy and editorial experiences, and one-off digital moments. You’ll work closely with Brand and Engineering to take projects from idea through launch while building reusable systems that make our web presence faster, more consistent, and more ambitious over time. This is a role for a strong brand designer who specializes in digital, not a traditional product designer. You should care deeply about typography, layout, interaction, motion, and the details that turn a website into a memorable brand experience. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own website design projects from initial concept through launch - Turn Kalshi’s visual identity into distinctive digital experiences - not simply place existing brand assets into templates - Develop strong creative concepts, page structures, visual systems, and interaction ideas - Design polished, responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile - Prototype motion, transitions, and interactive behaviors - Work directly with front-end engineers throughout development - Review builds, provide detailed design feedback, and ensure the finished website meets a high bar - Create and evolve reusable components and patterns that improve speed and consistency - Balance fast-moving launches with longer-term improvements to Kalshi’s website system - Help establish Kalshi’s visual and interaction language across the web - Proactively identify opportunities to make our websites clearer, more useful, and more memorable WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience designing websites and digital brand experiences - A portfolio centered on exceptional, shipped website work - Outstanding typography, composition, hierarchy, and visual-design judgment - Strong digital art-direction and brand-design skills - A deep understanding of responsive website design - Strong interaction and motion-design instincts - Advanced proficiency in Figma - Experience collaborating directly with front-end engineers - The ability to carry an idea from an early creative concept to a production-ready design - Excellent attention to detail, including the ability to spot and resolve differences between design and implementation - The judgment to move quickly when needed without compromising the quality of the work - The ability to independently lead projects in an ambitious, fast-moving environment BONUS - Designed websites for a highly recognizable consumer or technology brands - Created campaign sites, product launches, or interactive brand experiences - Built or evolved a website design system or reusable component library - Designed editorial, data-rich, or content-heavy websites - Worked closely with engineers on sophisticated web interactions - Experience in fintech, trading, sports, media, culture, or consumer technology - Experience at a high-growth startup or creative environment with a rapid pace NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE Salary Range: $115,000 to $180,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss. OUR CULTURE Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: Product Designer Our mission Boom https://www.boompay.app/ is on a mission to level the playing field for the 110+ million renters in the US by making housing more flexible, affordable, and rewarding. Boom is building a suite of rental financial services for renters and property managers, including tenant screening, rent payment reporting, rent reporting-as-a-service, and a number of integrations with the largest property management systems (PMS). Boom serves renters through the Boom App and property managers via the Boom Platform. Now serving thousands of renters, Boom is led by second-time founder Rob Whiting https://www.linkedin.com/in/robwhiting/ (ex-BCG, Rubicon). It's backed by investors such as Starting Line https://www.startingline.vc/, Clocktower Ventures https://www.clocktowerventures.com/, Gilgamesh Ventures https://www.gilgameshvc.com/ (Petal co-founders), and angels such as William Hockey https://www.forbes.com/sites/jeffkauflin/2022/04/21/plaids-billionaire-cofounder-is-back-with-a-new-startupa-fintech-friendly-bank-hes-running-with-his-wife/?sh=df10dc453908 and Zach Perret https://techcrunch.com/2021/01/14/plaid-ceo-touts-new-clarity-after-failed-visa-acquisition/ (Co-founders of Plaid) and Harry Stebbings https://techcrunch.com/2021/06/16/harry-stebbings-turns-up-the-volume-on-20vc-with-new-140m-fund/. Boom has been profiled by Inman https://www.inman.com/2023/10/30/new-boom-api-to-scale-reporting-of-tenant-payments-to-credit-bureaus/, Business Insider https://www.businessinsider.com/boom-pitch-deck-fintech-credit-builder-seed-2023-6, HousingWire https://www.housingwire.com/articles/rent-reporting-platform-boom-raises-4-5m-in-seed-round/, and more. Opportunity You will own design for key parts of BoomScreen, Boom's tenant screening and applicant verification product. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to turn user and business needs into intuitive, usable experiences, and report to our product/design lead. You'll partner daily with engineering, product, and other designers, with regular exposure to leadership as you take on more ownership. You'll need to be comfortable working across wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI, and translating ambiguous problems into clear, usable flows. This role is a great fit for someone who wants to own design end to end at a fast-moving startup, work hand-in-hand with engineers to ship what they design, and build on our existing design system and component library. It's not a great fit for someone who wants to work in isolation from engineering, focus mainly on research, or hand off concepts without following through to implementation. This role is based in Austin alongside our product, design, and engineering team. What you'll do - Design intuitive experiences across BoomScreen's web and mobile products, from applicant-facing screening flows to internal tools used by property managers - Turn ambiguous problems into user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma - Partner closely with engineers from early concepts through implementation to make sure what ships matches the design - Incorporate feedback from product, engineering, and other stakeholders into design revisions - Work within and help evolve Boom's design system, reusing and extending frontend components rather than reinventing patterns - Take ownership of assigned design work, surface problems, and propose solutions - Share work early and often for feedback from the team What you'll need - 2+ years of experience in product/UX design, ideally on digital products with both web and mobile surfaces - Strong proficiency with Figma - Solid grounding in user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and usability feedback - Experience working directly with engineers to take designs from concept to shipped product - Understanding of design systems and how to design within (and extend) a component library - Strong communication skills, including explaining design decisions and taking feedback from stakeholders - Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment - A portfolio link with your application. In interviews, we'll ask you to walk us through one or two projects in depth, so pick examples you know well Nice to haves - Experience at an early-stage startup - Experience designing for fintech, proptech, or other regulated products - Basic technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs and frontend/backend constraints with engineers - Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system - Familiarity with tools like Jira and PostHog Benefits of working at Boom - Competitive salary with stock options - Full healthcare coverage (health, dental, vision) including 50% coverage for dependents - 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year + 5 sick days + all US federal holidays (11 in total) (note: we think unlimited PTO is BS and causes some employees to feel guilty when they take it) - Company-issued laptop/MacBook - Company-sponsored training & development - Regular off-sites, retreats, and other company-sponsored events and travel opportunities

jobs.title: Consumer Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT BASE Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a product designer to help shape how people discover, understand, and get started with Base, while helping create a cohesive user experience across the customer journey. You'll work across our website, enrollment experience, and mobile app, improving existing experiences and building new features as we grow. You'll gather customer insights and use product metrics to identify opportunities, understand where people get stuck, and design solutions that improve usability, engagement, and conversion. You'll take ownership of problems, independently exploring ideas and bringing solutions to life. You'll work closely with engineering, growth, operations, and the design team to ship great experiences and continue improving them after launch. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Evolve our top-of-funnel experience. Continuously identify opportunities to improve how people discover, understand, and enroll with Base. Explore new approaches, benchmark great onboarding and conversion experiences, and experiment with everything from small copy and design changes to entirely new flows. Use conversion data to understand what works and keep raising the bar. - Shape and build what's next. Identify opportunities, explore new ideas, and take ownership of new features from concept through launch across our website and mobile app. - Let data guide your design decisions. Analyze product metrics, enrollment funnels, and member behavior to identify opportunities, uncover friction, challenge assumptions, and inform what to build and improve. - Own the outcomes, not just the output. Monitor product performance after launch, analyze results against your goals, and use those insights to guide future improvements. - Be a designer who builds. Use AI, code, and emerging tools to prototype ideas, explore possibilities, and turn concepts into working experiences. - Make the complex concepts feel simple. Find simple ways to make energy and the grid feel simple and approachable. - Help shape our design language. Collaborate with the product design team to evolve and build our design systems. - Balance multiple projects, knowing when to move quickly, when to go deeper, and how to prioritize the work that matters most. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 2 to 4 years of product design experience, ideally working on consumer products. - A portfolio that demonstrates strong visual craft, thoughtful interaction design, and clear problem solving. - Comfort working with product metrics and analytics to understand user behavior, identify friction, and make informed design decisions. - The ability to take a defined problem, explore different approaches, and independently drive a solution through launch. - Experience using product data, customer insights, and experimentation to identify opportunities, improve existing experiences, and measure impact. - Comfort using AI and new tools to go beyond traditional design workflows. We'd love to see something you've built, not just designed. - Strong Figma skills and experience working within and contributing to a design system. - Strong design judgment and the ability to make exceptional work within real-world constraints. - A resourceful, curious mindset. You're willing to figure things out, learn new skills, and find better ways to work. - A point of view on your work, paired with openness to feedback and collaboration. - Curiosity about energy, climate, or products that combine hardware and software. ABOUT THE TEAM The Design team shapes how people see, understand, and experience Base. We turn complex products and technology into something simple, approachable, and trustworthy. Our work touches nearly every part of the business, from launching new markets and building utility partnerships to helping homeowners understand a new kind of power company. We work across digital experiences, physical products, campaigns, sales, events, and everything in between. It's a rare opportunity to work across so many mediums, build things that exist in the real world, and help define what Base becomes as we grow. We're a small, ambitious team with a high bar for craft and a bias toward making things happen. We believe great design is about more than the final deliverable. It's about solving the right problems, building foundations for future work, and making everyone around us better. We value people with strong opinions, a sense of ownership, and the resourcefulness to make exceptional work within real constraints. Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive. OUR VALUES - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules. - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing. - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset. - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results. - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information. - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in. - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things. DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.
eligibilityReasons: Years of experience not clearly stated in the JD

Outstanding portfolio demonstrating excellence in motion design, visual storytelling, social-first content and campaign development, with a strong understanding of how to capture attention and engage consumer audiences. Strong understanding of design fundamentals, typography, composition, motion principles, editing, pacing, and visual storytelling for a consumer audience. Proven ability to translate creative briefs and campaign objectives into compelling, culturally relevant visual solutions. Creative Technology & AI Advanced proficiency in industry-standard creative tools including After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, and related software. Demonstrated experience creating AI-generated imagery and video for commercial marketing applications using platforms such as Veo, Imagen, Seedance , Higgsfield , ElevenLabs , GPT Image, Claude code or similar tools. Experience integrating AI throughout creative workflows, including concept development, storyboarding, content generation, asset adaptation, and production. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present ideas and work effectively across teams. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment. It’s great if you have: Filming, photography, and sound recording experience. Experience with 3D animation, compositing, CGI, or emerging content creation technologies. Experience creating content for global audiences and adapting creative across different markets, languages, or cultural contexts. jobs.title: Graduate UX Engineer 2027
jobs.descriptionText: Location: Bristol, UK Salary: £45,000 per annum Start date: September 2027 Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. The Graduate Programme at Graphcore Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are. What you’ll work on Put your design skills to work on clearer ways for people to understand complex AI workloads. In Graphcore’s UX team, you’ll help shape software used to understand and optimise workloads running on our hardware. Your work will make technical workflows easier to navigate and turn complex system behaviour into clear user experiences. With support from senior designers, you’ll create wireframes, high-fidelity designs and research materials. You’ll also help run usability studies, analyse findings and maintain our research repository, using what you learn to improve designs. Your team and support The UX team works closely with engineers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle. Design decisions are shaped by user insight, technical constraints and clear evidence. Your manager, Lucy, will work with you to build your skills, make time for learning and shape your career. Her favourite part of leadership is helping talented, driven people turn ideas into action, with the support and space to do their best work. You’ll also have a buddy to help you settle in, alongside a team of experienced designers keen to share what they know and help you develop. Josh recently joined us as a graduate and is confident, he’ll have discovered all the best lunch spots near the office by the time you arrive. He’s looking forward to sharing his favourites with you! You’ll contribute to Decagon, our design library, and help keep research insights useful and easy to find. The work moves from discovery to design, testing and iteration, and you will build confidence and take ownership of defined tasks. You’ll be encouraged to ask questions, challenge existing approaches and share ideas for making things better. We’ll support you to take responsibility for your work and speak up when you spot a problem or need help. Thoughtful discussion and clear communication help us learn from each other and improve our designs. How you’ll learn and grow During the two-year programme, you’ll build skills across user experience (UX), user interface (UI) design, research and design systems through real product work. Creating designs and helping run usability studies will give you practical experience of exploring user needs, testing ideas and turning findings into improvements. Contributing to Decagon will help you understand how a shared design library supports consistent interfaces. Working with senior designers, engineers and product managers will help you explain your design decisions, respond to feedback and understand how user needs and technical constraints shape a product. What we’re looking for A degree in UX, Interaction Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design or a related discipline UX/UI design experience and a portfolio demonstrating your UX thinking, design process and visual skills Proficiency in design tools such as Figma or Adobe XD Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an interest in designing for complex, technical or business-to-business (B2B) software products Your experience can come from academic or personal projects, internships or placements. In your portfolio, show the problem you explored, how you approached it, the design decisions you made and what you learned. Benefits Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. Sponsorship Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities. Introduction to Graphcore At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together. How to apply and what to expect To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring. Ready to put your learning into practice? Start your UX career in a permanent role, with two years of hands-on learning through the Graphcore Graduate Programme. Apply now and help shape what comes next.

jobs.title: UI Artist
jobs.descriptionText: WHAT MAKES US EPIC? At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating. Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development. ART What We Do Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire. What You'll Do As a UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players. In this role, you will have the ability to take wireframes and bring them to life while improving the UX with visuals. You will also implement final art in Unreal Editor using UMG, animations, materials, etc. In this role, you will Work collaboratively with UX Design, Tech UI Design, and Engineering to create AAA-quality UI experiences Actively participate in the creation and implementation of design systems, game menus, HUD elements, Iconography, UI materials and shaders, UI animation, and motion design Create new material effects, implement basic logic in blueprints, and/or create 2D effects Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art What we're looking for You have 2+ years of experience working collaboratively to create UI from concept to completion Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes You have a passion for making and playing games and have a strong sense of player empathy You are a proactive individual who naturally leans into owning outcomes and is able to deal with ambiguity well and adapt to changes of plan quickly EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees. ABOUT US Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent. Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here . Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT WARP Warp is the AI-native Employee Management Platform for ambitious companies. HRIS, payroll, benefits, IT, tax compliance, and more, all built from scratch on one AI-native platform. Every company runs on its people, and the software that manages them is some of the oldest in the enterprise. Incumbents like ADP and Workday built their businesses on complexity and large ops teams. The Role The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other. Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. Core Responsibilities • Interaction and visual design. As a product designer, you'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. jobs.descriptionText: WHAT IS KALSHI? Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. - Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. - Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. ROLE ROADMAP We are looking for an outlier Product Designer to help craft the experience of prediction markets through elegant and simple UX and delightful product interactions. You will own the core customer journeys, including how our users discover, research, trade, manage their positions in, and reference prediction markets. Your role will push you to be close to customers and to bring creative solutions to their needs, including the ones they’re not aware of. If you love creating moments of delight, you deeply care for our craft, and you are excited to bring prediction markets to the world, this role is for you. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Create awe: build delightful product experiences that make our customers go from liking the product to loving it - Simplify and distill: promote accessibility to Kalshi and take complicated financial actions and turn them into elegant, simple, and easy to understand product flows - Research and talk to customers: refine and improve our understanding of our customers and their needs, including those they’re not aware of - Rapidly produce concepts and prototypes: apply an experimental and iterative mindset to design and solution exploration WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in product design - A compelling portfolio showcasing your ability to craft delightful product experiences (show us!) - Deeply in love with your craft, obsessive over design details, and focused on excellence in execution. - Strong customer intuition and consumer sensibility - Ability to move fast and adjust quickly, in a dynamic, fast-paced environment - Passion for prediction markets and/or financial markets - Bonus: past experience in consumer fintech or trading NYC PAY TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE Base Salary Range: $180,000–$270,000 This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out — we’re always happy to discuss. OUR CULTURE Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT US Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right. Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent-dense team where everyone is enabled to do best work of their careers. THE ROLE Our agents already do the work. They make the calls, read the records, and close the file. What we have not built yet is the thing our customers sit in all day while that happens. Right now that surface is an interface an engineer put together so the agents had somewhere to report. It works. It was never designed. In the next few months the largest insurance companies in the country start running real claims operations through it, and it has to hold up as the system their users live in. We are hiring our first designer to own that. Every surface a customer touches, from the screen an examiner opens at 8am to the report an executive reads on Friday. You will build the design language, the research practice, and the bar for everyone who joins after you. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own every surface a customer touches. The claims workspace, the review and exception flows, how an agent shows its work and its sources, the reporting an executive sponsor reads. You decide what good looks like, and you are accountable for whether it ships that way. Turn an agent platform into a system people work in. Our customers are replacing software they have used for twenty years. That means density, explicit state, and interfaces that make frequent tasks faster. Design the interaction model for agents doing real work. A user has to see what the agent did, why, what it read, and where it was unsure, then agree or intervene. You’ll shape that experience with users and engineers. Ship it. You turn customer problems surfaced by FDEs or customers into clear workflows and drive them with engineering from discovery through delivery, owning usability and measuring whether the solution works for users. Find and measure friction. Own UX instrumentation and analysis, combine behavioral data with user research, and test whether changes help users complete their work with less effort. Set the bar. Build the design system and the principles behind it. As design grows here, you are the natural person to lead it. YOU - 5+ years designing software, with end-to-end ownership - Portfolio depth in dense, technical software. Something an operator uses for six hours a day - You sit with the person doing the job, watch what confuses them, and change the design instead of defending it - High agency. Nobody assigns you work and there is no design team to hide inside - Based in NYC and excited to work in person NICE TO HAVE - Exposure to insurance, claims, healthcare, or another compliance-heavy operational domain - You have designed for AI products and have opinions about citations, confidence, and human-in-the-loop flows - Brand and visual identity work - Early-stage startup experience, especially as the first hire in a function WHAT WE BELIEVE IN - Eating well: We provide lunch and dinner every workday from local restaurants. - Health & Wellness: Your health is on us. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, offer up to $17,000 toward fertility and family-forming through Carrot, and give you a monthly gym stipend to stay active. - Getting out of the office together to recharge: quarterly offsites somewhere you actually want to go.

jobs.title: Product Designer II
jobs.descriptionText: ABOUT AIPRISE AiPrise is a YC-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world. Through a single integration, we connect 800+ data sources and 80+ verification partners across 200+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge. Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount. We're ~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day. Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be. THE ROLE As a Product Designer II at AiPrise, you'll own design for a defined feature area of our compliance platform end to end, turning complicated processes, data, and decisions into clear, intuitive experiences. Our platform serves compliance analysts reviewing flagged cases, compliance managers configuring the rules that decide what gets flagged, business customers completing verification for the first time, and our own Forward-Deployed Engineering team standing up and supporting customer workflows. Depending on where you're working, you'll design for several of them. You'll work with product and engineering to take defined problems from discovery through launch. The problem and its owner will be clear; how it gets solved is where you come in. We move fast and share work early, so expect feedback from customers and teammates to shape your designs while they're still taking form. You'll partner closely with product and engineering, with enough proximity to leadership to see why decisions get made and how your work lands with customers. Our priorities and processes will keep evolving as we grow, so you'll prioritize your own work with limited oversight and change course when new information arrives. WHAT YOU'LL DO DESIGN JUDGMENT - Make design decisions independently within your feature area, applying and extending our design system where it needs to stretch. - Weigh user needs, design quality, delivery speed, business priorities, and technical constraints, and catch usability problems before they reach engineering. - Build working domain expertise in the compliance and verification workflows your feature area touches, deep enough to connect your day-to-day design work to roadmap goals and explain how it ladders up to quarterly objectives. EXECUTION - Own medium-complexity projects end to end, from discovery and exploration through final design, implementation, and launch, with minimal oversight. - Create clear user flows, prototypes, final designs, and documentation, anticipating edge cases and the non-happy paths that make compliance software either trustworthy or infuriating. CUSTOMER & DATA INSIGHTS - Combine customer conversations, usability testing, and product analytics to validate design decisions and identify problems worth solving, rather than only responding to the feedback in front of you. - Work with internal teams who sit closest to customers to pressure-test what you're seeing in the data. COMMUNICATION & INFLUENCE - Partner closely with product and engineering to clarify the problem, requirements, constraints, and measures of success. - Explain your design rationale clearly, contribute confidently in product and planning discussions, and keep stakeholders current on progress, risks, and open questions. - Help newer designers get better, through design reviews, feedback, and pairing on tricky problems. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years as a product designer, with a track record of shipping features and workflows to customers. - Experience designing complex B2B, enterprise, fintech, compliance, identity, fraud, risk, or other data-heavy products, where the hard part was the information and not the interface. - A portfolio that shows how you frame problems, use research and data, explore solutions, and make design decisions, not just the final screens. - Fluency in interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and prototyping, with the attention to edge cases and implementation quality that complex products demand. - Clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with product managers and engineers.

jobs.descriptionText: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. We help businesses receive, store, send, and spend their money in one place — with faster access to funds, global money movement, and cards for everyday spending. Instead of stitching together banks, payment processors, and financial tools, businesses can manage their money where they already run their payments. Our ambition is to make managing business finances feel as intuitive and thoughtfully designed as the best consumer products. That means making sophisticated capabilities accessible, bringing clarity to complex workflows, and paying close attention to the details that help people feel confident and in control of their money. What you’ll do As a Product Designer on the Treasury team, you’ll help rethink an essential part of running a business. Your work could help businesses access their earnings sooner, understand their cash flow, move money across currencies and borders, or manage everyday spending — all within a connected experience on Stripe. You’ll work across new and existing products, shaping zero-to-one experiences and refining the details of what’s already in users’ hands. You’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering to define problems, explore possibilities, and bring high-quality experiences to life. This work involves substantial ambiguity and technical and regulatory complexity; your role is to make the experience feel simple without losing the rigor that financial products demand. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end product design process, from understanding user needs and defining problems through prototyping, detailed design, launch, and iteration.
