Bring clarity to ambiguous problems, using research, exploration, and prototypes to establish direction and turn early ideas into products people can use. Deliver exceptional interaction and visual design, bringing a consumer-grade standard of usability, polish, and care to complex financial tools. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap around meaningful, measurable user outcomes. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to understand constraints and find thoughtful solutions that protect users without introducing unnecessary friction. Work with user researchers, content designers, and other product designers to validate ideas and create a consistent experience across Treasury and the broader Stripe Dashboard. Work closely with engineers through implementation, refining interactions and details so the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar. Share work regularly in design reviews, explain your decisions clearly, and use feedback to strengthen your work. jobs.title: Technical Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US. ABOUT THE ROLE You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked. That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything. We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you. WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON - Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building. - Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it. - Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so. - Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you. - Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong. - Evidence of analytics. You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered. - Taste. You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made. - Real code shipped to real users. React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it. - AI as leverage, not as identity. We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made. - German and English. Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one. How we work In the office, Munich, five days a week. We build in the same room — decisions happen at desks, not in tickets. Relocation support if you're not here yet. High pace, steep learning curve. Most of the team is here well past six. That's not a policy or a number we track, it's what building something this size with sixteen people currently takes, and it's a phase, not a permanent state. If you're optimising for predictable hours right now, this is the wrong role, and that's a completely reasonable thing to be optimising for. This is not the role if you want specs handed to you, you separate "my design work" from "my engineering work," you need a design system before you can start, or your best work needs a slide to explain it. ABOUT THE FOUNDERS We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean, the co-founders of Mercura. We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility. Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs. Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry. At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins. Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: About Elyos AI We’re building the next generation of customer service with AI Agents. Our agents answer calls, reply to emails and WhatsApp messages, make bookings, take payments, and operate the CRM in the same way a human would. We founded Elyos in June 2023 and took part in the Y Combinator S23 batch. Our founders spent four months in San Francisco living and breathing AI. Since then, we’ve been growing revenue ~30% month on month and shipping fast. It’s been wild so far - and we’re just getting started. We recently raised a $13m series A to turbocharge our growth. The product has grown faster than any one of us can hold in our head - agent configuration, calls, email, campaigns, scheduling - and design has been shared out across whoever happened to be building the feature. It needs an owner. Someone to give it one language, and enough depth that it holds up when hundreds of customers use it in ways we didn't plan for. There are two sides to it. How the agents behave, on the phone and in the inbox and over chat. And the product behind them, where a trade business sets up what its agents do and checks what they did. You'd be our first designer, working directly with the two CEOs, the CTO and with engineers to build what you design. The work, roughly in order: - How our customers work alongside their agents. Watching a call, correcting the agent, deciding what it can and can't do, trusting it a bit more next time. Nobody has good patterns for this yet. - One design language. Type, colour, icons, components, written down and held to. - Joining the product up. Onboarding, creating an agent, setting up on-call, reviewing what it books - separate islands today, and you'd be central to fixing it. You'll spend real time with customers. They run vans, not product teams, and they'll tell you exactly what's wrong. Their current software was designed in the 2000s and has been cobbled together ever since. Nobody has seriously designed for this industry. There's nothing to inherit and nothing to copy, so the patterns would be yours to set. And they're the best users you could ask for: they've never had good software, so they know within a day whether something works. We're looking for someone who's designed something genuinely complicated. Dense screens, real operational workflows, software people sit in all day. You prototype fast, you're fluent with AI tools, and you won't be the one shipping the React unless you want to be. You'll need opinions and the willingness to push them. Brand and the marketing site sit elsewhere. This is the product. GymBox, 1Rebel, F45 etc) - 📚 AI-focused learning & development - stay ahead of the curve. - ✈️ Team socials & annual offsites - cool destinations included (last year we went to Greece!). - 🏥 Private healthcare - because your well-being matters.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionText: THIS ROLE CAN BE OFFICE-BASED IN FREIBURG (GERMANY) / SAN FRANCISCO (USA) OR HYBRID WITH A REQUIREMENT TO BE IN ONE OF THE OFFICES ONE FULL WEEK PER MONTH. ABOUT BLACK FOREST LABS We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. WHY THIS ROLE Black Forest Labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. For a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. It's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. It has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do. We're hiring our first Brand Designer to define that brand and own it wherever people meet BFL. You'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how BFL looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between. This is a hands-on lead role. You'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. Over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at BFL, including who we hire next. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Lead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from. - Create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do. - Make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print. - Own the direction of bfl.ai http://bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand. - Build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. We'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset. - Work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai http://bfl.ai, the Playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company. YOUR TEAM Design at BFL is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. You'll help define these and represent design across the company. You'll work closely with Devran https://www.linkedin.com/in/devran-dogaroglu-2a763a8a/, who leads design at BFL, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. Among the people you'll work with most are Owais https://www.linkedin.com/in/owais-khan1/ and Aitana https://www.linkedin.com/in/aitana-giebels-van-bekestein/ in marketing and Jay https://www.linkedin.com/in/papisan/ in growth engineering. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. We're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail. - Deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. You notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks. - A quality bar that raises the work around you. You've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave. - You're ready to ship from day one. You've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved. - A systems thinker. You've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind. - You move easily between the big picture and the details. You can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them. - You're comfortable with ambiguity. One week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai http://bfl.ai. Much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity. - Curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. You can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work. Nice to have: - Shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with AI coding tools such as Claude Code. - Building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps. - Using generative image or video models in your creative process. - Motion, 3D or creative coding. - Experience at an AI lab. HOW WE WORK TOGETHER We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg or San Francisco to stay connected with the team. Everything we do is grounded in four values: - Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. - Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. - Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. - Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. Please apply even if you don't match every line above. What matters most to us is curiosity and a love of making things. You don't need to know every tool we use. We'd rather hire a great, curious designer than someone who ticks every box. If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you. Compensation EU : €148K - €175K + equity SF : $219K - $265K + equity

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionText: A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realising a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other. Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components. You consider things like API documentation, SDK functionality, and developer onboarding and can speak the language of a developer. You have familiarity with existing developer tooling and have strong understanding of developer workflows. Core Responsibilities • Interaction and visual design. As a product designer, you'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience with mockup and prototyping tools. • User research. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. • Prototyping. You will prototype, both to communicate your designs and validate your decisions. • Partnering with engineers. We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products. • Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies. Resources and mentorship are available to designers who want to learn more. Designers at Palantir have great autonomy over their work, so a wide skill set is necessary. However, many designers on the team are also passionate experts in one area. You might be the kind of designer who ships code every week, or the kind of designer who shares detailed user research findings with your team.

jobs.title: Senior Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionText: At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. Senior Graphic Designer Why We Have This Role At Qualtrics, visual communication shapes how the world experiences our brand. We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer to translate complex business strategies into compelling visual stories across our digital, marketing, and event platforms. Working alongside marketing managers, copywriters, and fellow designers, you will take full ownership of major creative initiatives while mentoring rising talent on the team. Your work will directly elevate our brand presence and ensure every customer touchpoint is thoughtful, high-quality, and impactful. How You’ll Find Success Mastery of Modern Design Tools: Expert-level skill in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) and Figma. Core Visual Craft: A strong foundation in typography, visual storytelling, and design principles with painstaking attention to detail. Growth Mindset: An open, positive approach to constructive feedback and creative iteration. Autonomous Execution: The ability to manage multiple priorities and lead projects from concept to delivery in a fast-paced environment. Articulate Communication: Confidence in explaining design decisions and presenting concepts clearly to non-design stakeholders. Mentorship & Collaboration: A passion for sharing best practices and supporting the growth of junior and mid-level designers. Adaptive Skills (Bonus): Familiarity or curiosity with basic motion graphics (After Effects) or video editing. How You’ll Grow Expand your leadership capabilities through formal and informal mentorship of junior and mid-level team members. Develop skills in motion graphics and video editing by incorporating dynamic assets into major marketing initiatives. Deepen your strategic impact by leading environmental and visual branding for major corporate events and global campaigns. Things You’ll Do Drive customer engagement by leading the design and execution of high-impact visual assets across marketing collateral, digital ads, social media, presentations, websites, and events. Guard brand integrity by maintaining design consistency across all touchpoints and continuously refining global brand guidelines as Qualtrics evolves. Elevate campaign performance by translating marketing objectives into innovative, cross-platform visual solutions that resonate with target audiences. Deliver quality under dynamic deadlines by owning assigned project workflows, managing feedback loops, and ensuring timely final delivery. Foster cross-functional alignment by collaborating with marketing, product, sales, and creative teams to translate business requirements into impactful visuals. Scale team excellence by providing actionable feedback, sharing best practices, and mentoring junior design talent. What We’re Looking For On Your Resume A strong, curated online portfolio demonstrating solid design fundamentals, typography, creative problem-solving, and a variety of print, digital, and environmental work. Proven track record of independently managing and executing multi-channel creative projects from strategy to final delivery. Demonstrated experience collaborating cross-functionally and presenting design rationales clearly to key stakeholders. Hands-on experience with major event design or motion graphics/video editing is a plus. What You Should Know About This Team Growth-focused culture valuing curiosity, high integrity, and team collaboration. Emphasis on long-term relationship development alongside new business growth. A tight-knit, high-performing team dedicated to breaking new ground in Experience Management. Culture of high ownership and performance. Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits 100% merit-based promotions, driven by results and impact rather than politics or tenure. Flexible hybrid work environment. Catered lunches, quarterly team socials, winter and summer parties, and extensive Qualtrics swag. Private health insurance, and a wellness stipend to support your personal well-being and growth. The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. ​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. jobs.title: Senior UX Designer – Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.descriptionText: Riot is looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Sydney-based team and help create player-centered experiences for an Unpublished R&D Product. Riot’s mission is to put players at the centre of everything we do. We achieve this by continuing to create, evolve, and deliver new experiences with games like Teamfight Tactics, League of Legends and VALORANT. As a Senior UX Designer working on an Unpublished R&D Product, you will own the design of significant player-facing features and help shape the product and feature vision. You’ll work across complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, partnering with designers, artists, engineers, producers, and other stakeholders to understand player needs and turn product goals into intuitive, accessible, and engaging experiences. Your work will span discovery, strategy, interaction design, interface design, prototyping, and implementation. You’ll lead UX direction for features, establish alignment across disciplines, communicate design rationale, and support the team in delivering a cohesive player experience. You will report to a Senior Design Leader supporting the R&D Game Team. Responsibilities: Own UX design for significant player-facing features and systems from early discovery through implementation and iteration. Lead the exploration and conceptualization of UX opportunities, helping teams clarify player problems, product goals, and success measures. Define and communicate UX direction through appropriate design artifacts, including strategy and alignment frameworks, research and discovery outcomes, journey maps, flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and implementation documentation. Translate complex ideas into intuitive interaction and interface designs informed by player needs, usability principles, and project goals. Establish and evolve UX patterns and design system contributions that improve consistency and quality across relevant game experiences. Partner closely with engineering, UI, and technical teams during implementation to resolve design challenges, support prototypes, and help ensure a high-quality final experience. Facilitate design reviews and communicate design decisions clearly, influencing cross-functional partners and incorporating feedback from players and development teams. Collaborate with research, playtest, and analytics partners to plan evaluations, synthesize findings, and use evidence to improve the player experience. Consider platform and multiplatform needs when developing solutions that support the product’s broader experience strategy. Raise the quality of UX practice on the team by sharing knowledge, modelling strong collaboration, and supporting the growth of other designers. Required Qualifications: 6+ years of experience as a UX, Interaction, or Product Designer working on digital products or games, or equivalent depth of experience. Proven experience owning end-to-end design for complex features, systems, or products in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Strong interaction and interface design skills, with proficiency in Figma for design systems, prototyping, presentation, and communicating implementation intent. Experience navigating complex and ambiguous problems, creating clarity, and making sound design decisions with cross-disciplinary stakeholders. Ability to articulate a compelling UX direction and influence product, design, engineering, and production partners. Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across design and non-design audiences. A portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, player-centered design process and shipped or implemented work. Desired Qualifications: BA/BS degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or equivalent experience. Experience designing for games, social platforms, or live digital services. Familiarity with Unreal Engine or other game development tools for implementation and prototyping. Experience with user research, usability testing, playtesting, analytics, or analyzing player feedback. Experience contributing to or leading design systems, interaction patterns, or multiplatform experiences. Experience working on distributed or cross-studio teams. Experience mentoring designers or contributing to UX craft standards and best practices. For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role! We will review your work as part of the application process, so please provide a portfolio link or work samples with your application. Our Perks: At Riot we strongly believe in work / life balance, and we encourage that with our open paid time off policy, paid parental leave (for both primary and secondary carers) and flexible work schedules to fit your lifestyle. We also believe that work should be fun, we have co-op gaming areas, a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of players and community, and all the snacks you would ever need to power through your day (even healthy snacks!). And that’s not all we offer, there’s also: Medical Insurance that covers you and your dependents Employee Assistance Program Wellness fund Donation matching of time and money to registered charities Learning and Development opportunities At Riot Games, we put players first . That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer, Experiential
jobs.descriptionText: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Brand Studio lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. We do this by creating, evolving, and maintaining Stripe's high-quality, versatile, and forward-looking brand design systems, experiences, and advertising campaigns. We sweat the details. We make it seem effortless. The Experiential team is responsible for bringing Stripe's brand to life in the real world, from flagship events and industry conferences to internal summits and curated partner experiences. This team operates at the intersection of creativity, strategy, technology, and production. What you’ll do Senior Brand Designers at Stripe demonstrate a passion for the craft of design and a deep understanding of how design communicates brand essence. You will be responsible for defining and advancing Stripe's experiential design systems across physical experiences, digital surfaces, and mainstage creative content. You work at the intersection of design systems, concepting, and storytelling, creating design frameworks that scale while still feeling intentional and human. Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end design of experiential programs, from early concepts and storytelling through detailed design, production, and launch. Translate Stripe’s brand and product strategy into compelling physical, digital, and hybrid experiences for global audiences. Create scalable visual identities, design systems, and toolkits for events and environments that extend Stripe’s evolving brand. Art direct agencies, fabricators, contractors, and other external partners; provide clear feedback and uphold quality through execution. Design keynote and presentation systems that make complex ideas feel clear, cohesive, and engaging. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Mobile
jobs.descriptionText: Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ABOUT THE ROLE For a substantial number of Quo's customers, mobile isn't a secondary surface — it's where the work happens. As our mobile experience continues to become more and more central to how small businesses run their day, the bar for quality and craft has to rise with it. We're looking for a senior product designer to help lead that charge. You'll own end-to-end design across our iOS and Android apps, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and the rest of the Product Design team to ship experiences that feel native, fast, and unmistakably Quo. This is a role for someone who excels in platform-specific patterns, has a high craft bar, strong mobile product taste, and who's comfortable using AI tools as part of how they design and build. SOME OF THE THINGS YOU’LL DO: - Own key mobile design projects end to end, from early concepts and ideation through to implementation and post-launch iterations - Build out the systems, components, principles, and guidelines for other designers to follow as they contribute to the mobile experience - Bring deep fluency in both iOS and Android platform conventions, using native patterns where they serve the customer, and pushing back on cross-platform shortcuts when they don't - Prototype concepts in code when it's more effective than static mocks, using tools like Claude Code to explore and validate ideas early and often - Partner closely with mobile engineers and cross-functional stakeholders, representing the voice of mobile customers and making the case for platform-level nuance - Identify opportunities for delight and friction reduction that no one asked for, and take the initiative to design and ship them - Give and seek out feedback, participate in critiques, and help raise the quality and craft bar for the whole design team ABOUT YOU - 5+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio showing depth, experience, and platform-specific judgment across iOS and Android applications - Exceptional craft and attention to detail across user experience, interface, interaction, and visual design - Strong point of view on what makes mobile software feel great, knowing when to stay on top of current trends and best practices, and when to venture off and break the mold - Track record of owning projects end to end with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the right problem through to shipping and learning - Deep knowledge and experience using Figma, and comfort prototyping in code when it's better than static mocks - Proven ability to partner closely with engineering, articulating the reasoning behind design decisions and navigating technical constraints early - Demonstrated understanding of the importance of keeping things simple, and ensuring that nothing gets in the way of the customer experience and value NICE TO HAVE: - Motion design experience for mobile-native transitions and microinteractions - Experience designing for web/desktop applications - UX copywriting instincts COMPENSATION The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: - SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $166,000 - $195,000 USD - All other US Locations: $150,000 - $175,000 USD - Canada: $155,000 - $182,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. WHO WE ARE We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. #LI-Remote #PostLI

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer - Hospitality
jobs.descriptionText: This hybrid role requires working in the office two days per week. With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture. About the job OpenTable helps restaurants turn guests into regulars and the Hospitality team is where that promise is designed. As Principal Product Designer, you will own the design vision for how restaurants communicate with their guests, using AI to speed the process without sacrificing a personal touch. You will set design strategy across the Hospitality portfolio, partnering with product, engineering, data, and research leaders to shape what we build and why. Your work will directly influence whether restaurants trust the guest information we give them and act on it to deliver better service and bring more guests back. This role will report directly to the Design Director of Hospitality. Responsibilities Lead the design vision and strategy for guest communication, helping restaurants send timely, personalized messages that keep their guests engaged. Shape multi-year product direction across the Hospitality portfolio with cross-functional partners, translating business goals into a coherent user experience. Turn complex guest data into interfaces restaurants trust and use, from recognizing a returning guest to acting on that context during service. Deliver high-quality end-to-end design, framing the problem through polished, accessible interfaces and raising the bar for craft across the team. Build alignment on design decisions with senior stakeholders through clear storytelling, prototypes, and evidence from research. Mentor designers and strengthen shared design practices, patterns, and critique across the organization. **When applying, please include your online portfolio link and password in the application. We are reviewing portfolios thoroughly as part of the selection process and we appreciate the opportunity to learn more about you and your work. Thank you! Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of professional product design experience, including leading design for complex, large-scale products. A portfolio demonstrating design strategy, interaction design, and exceptional visual craft across web and mobile. Expertise in Figma and modern prototyping tools. Proven ability to set and drive design vision with cross-functional partners in product, engineering, and research. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of articulating and defending design decisions to senior audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience incorporating AI tools into design workflows to improve speed and quality of outcomes. Experience designing for two-sided marketplaces or for both consumer and business users. Familiarity with designing for data quality, identity, or personalization systems. Benefits and Perks 5 weeks paid vacation Private health & dental insurance Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year Focus on mental health and well-being: Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth Company-paid subscription to Headspace Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) Paid parental leave Time off for your birthday Paid volunteer time Focus on your career growth: Development Dollars Leadership development Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings Travel Discounts Employee Resource Groups Income protection and life assurance Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice Pension plan contributions Discounted gym membership Bike2Work Season ticket loan Social events & Thursday happy hours Free lunch 2 days per week The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility. Work Environment & Flexibility At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations. Inclusion We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations. #LI-SK1 #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead
jobs.descriptionText: Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer BACKGROUND Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand: a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce. We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built. THE ROLE We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar. We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool. Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition. Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's. If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk. You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces - Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI - Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction - Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt - Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials - Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner - Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact REQUIREMENTS - 6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems - Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company - AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role - Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against - Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code - Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale HOW TO APPLY We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools. Go to nash.ai https://nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand and explore the brand system https://nash.ai/brand. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output. Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea. Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours. A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed. More about Nash http://Nash.AI NASH IS THE PLATFORM THAT POWERS MODERN LOGISTICS. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead
jobs.descriptionText: Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer BACKGROUND Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand: a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce. We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built. THE ROLE We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar. We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool. Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition. Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's. If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk. You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces - Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI - Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction - Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt - Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials - Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner - Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact REQUIREMENTS - 6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems - Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company - AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role - Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against - Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code - Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale HOW TO APPLY We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools. Go to nash.ai https://nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it https://nash.ai/blog/equilibrium-in-motion-introducing-the-new-nash-brand and explore the brand system https://nash.ai/brand. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output. Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea. Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours. A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed. More about Nash http://Nash.AI NASH IS THE PLATFORM THAT POWERS MODERN LOGISTICS. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. jobs.title: Senior Content Designer, Conversational AI
jobs.descriptionText: Ibotta is seeking a Senior Content Designer focused on conversational and AI-driven experiences, to join our UX team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. Our products are moving from forms and screens toward systems that explain their own reasoning, recommend actions, and increasingly act on a user's behalf. In those products the content is the interface rather than a layer applied on top of it. This role builds the content layer of our design system so that it works for people and for the agents acting on their behalf. You will partner closely with product management, product design, UX research, and engineering to craft content that makes complex products feel simple, trustworthy, and easy to use. This role is crucial in ensuring our products speak with a clear, consistent voice, regardless of where a user accesses our tools. This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States. Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one. What you will be doing: - Build the content and AI experience layer of our design system: voice, patterns, error and empty states, and the language of system reasoning, structured so both designers and agents can consume it - Turn our content standards into tools and structures that designers and agents can use directly - Rebuild and scale the AI content tools product teams use, so first-pass content holds up without a content designer reviewing every screen - Fix how content work moves between content, design, product and engineering, so requests stop arriving as one-off tickets - Design conversational and agentic experiences, including how a system explains what it is doing, what it is uncertain about, and what it needs from the user - Shape how our agents behave as well as what they say, including the instructions behind them and when an agent should check with the user before it acts or pass the work to a person - Decide with engineering when a scripted flow serves people better than a generated response, and design for both - Write the language that carries trust in AI-generated output, where a user is committing budget against a recommendation they cannot audit - Partner with product designers on product content across internal tools, publisher experiences, and client-facing products - Define content standards and guidelines, and make them usable by people who are not content designers - Use research and data to evaluate whether content is working, and change it when it is not - Set up a repeatable way to review the quality of AI-generated responses, and use what you learn to improve them - Work with engineering on the limits an agent works within and the tools and data it can reach, so what ships behaves the way it was designed - Present and rationalize work at product and design reviews - Embrace and uphold Ibotta's Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, and A Good Idea Can Come from Anywhere What we are looking for: - 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, or a related field. Ideal candidates will have experience with consumer-facing products as well as B2B environments such as SaaS platforms, marketplaces, or self-service tools. - Bachelor's degree in UX, Journalism, English, Psychology, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience - A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end content design work that demonstrates your writing process, problem-solving skills, examples of polished UI copy, and a measurable impact on the user experience. - Experience designing conversational interfaces, assistant or agent experiences, or AI-driven product surfaces - Experience building content systems and standards rather than writing screen by screen - Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to present and defend content decisions to cross-functional and senior stakeholders. - Experience building or scaling content systems, style guides, or governance frameworks across multiple teams or products. - Familiarity with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), collaboration and documentation tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), and AI tooling - Hands-on experience writing and testing prompts or system instructions for products built on large language models - Comfortable working with engineers on how a product is built, including the data and services an agent depends on - A deep curiosity for understanding users and empathizing with their problems, paired with the judgment to know when data should override a strong opinion. - Ability to work independently as the specialist in the room and bring others along - Ability to manage competing priorities and ask for help when needed - Ability to communicate the content experience to executives and stakeholders About Ibotta ("I bought a...") Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2.6 billion through the IPN since 2012. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine. To learn more about what our Tech teams are doing day to day, visit Building Ibotta on https://medium.com/building-ibottaMedium.com http://Medium.com Additional Details: - This position is located in Denver, CO and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, benefits package (including medical, dental, vision), Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals. - Base compensation range: $131,000 - $153,000. Equity is included in overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience. - Ibotta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ibotta’s employment decisions are made without regard of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. - Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. - Applicants are accepted until the position is filled. - For the security of our employees and the business, all employees are responsible for the secure handling of data in accordance with our security policies, identifying and reporting phishing attempts, as well as reporting security incidents to the proper channels. Use prototypes, code and AI tools to make ideas tangible, test interactions and resolve key questions before development. - A consistent Eight Sleep experience. Work closely with product, engineering and brand to make sure the app feels as considered as everything else we put into the world. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - 10+ years experience - A track record of shipping at a staff level. You’ve led significant work on native iOS and Android products at scale and can show its impact. - Exceptional visual and interaction craft. Your work holds up alongside the best consumer products. You care about typography, hierarchy, motion and the details that make an experience feel finished. You think about how it behaves, transitions and responds. - A portfolio that shows your judgment. Walk us through the problem, the decisions, the tradeoffs and what happened after the work shipped. - The ability to see the whole system. You understand how individual features fit together and can create patterns that hold up as a product grows. - Experience with health, biometric or other data-rich consumer products. You know how to make complex information useful and approachable. - Deep Figma fluency. You’re comfortable designing, prototyping and building systems that other people can use. - Hands-on experience with AI tools. You’re already using tools like Cursor and Claude to explore, prototype and build. Show us something you’ve made. - Ownership in ambiguity. You can take an open-ended problem, form a point of view and move it forward. You know when to explore, when to make a decision and how to bring people with you. - Confidence in the room. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - 60 days: You understand the product and its members, have identified the biggest structural and craft gaps, and have shipped your first meaningful improvement. - 6 months: The new app architecture is shipping, with evidence that members can more easily find key features and understand their data. OUR CURRENT DESIGN PRIORITIES 🌟 Our Design community red thread is to grow our brand design practice and ensure consistency in order to build an established and memorable brand. To succeed in this mission, we currently: - Consolidating and scaling our visual identity across every touchpoint: web, email, ads, social, and increasingly our own landing pages, where brand expression and conversion design meet. - Growing our motion and video capability: it's a big plus for this role, not a nice-to-have. - Creating impactful physical and event experiences that bring the brand to life beyond screens. - You are at the cutting edge of AI-enabled design and creative workflows, actively experimenting with emerging models and tools and turning them into practical ways to improve the quality, speed, and impact of your work. - Extending brand identity into our Health & Prevention area, alongside our core Marketing & Brand responsibilities. - Shaping how Alan's mascot and visual universe show up, used deliberately, not everywhere. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionText: Who We Are Founded in 2023, Small Axe Studios is 2K’s newest stand-alone studio, built to push the boundaries of game development and bring 2K’s next groundbreaking sports franchise to life. Headquartered in Burnaby, we are assembling a world-class team of visionaries, builders, and passionate gamers who thrive on creative collaboration, technical excellence, and bold ideas. At Small Axe Studios, we believe big things start with sharp focus—and we’re crafting an exceptional, player-first experience from the ground up. If you’re ready to tackle unique challenges, leave your mark on a brand-new IP, and help shape the future of interactive sports entertainment, we want you on our team! What We Need Do you see UI as more than menus and icons—as a core part of a game’s identity and experience Do you see UI as more than menus and icons — as the connective tissue between player intent and player experience? What You’ll Do Design Own and maintain the atomic design system based in Figma. Design and refine player flows, wireframes, interaction patterns, and information hierarchies that improve clarity, usability, and comprehension. Translate complex player needs and gameplay systems into intuitive, elegant UX solutions. Iterate on designs and solutions that enhance usability, clarity, and emotional impact. Guide adaptation of core gameplay, controls, and menu experiences across multiple platforms and input methods, ensuring parity and quality across all environments. Visual & Art Help define the game's UI visual style in partnership with the Art Director and Design team. Translate wireframes and UX systems into refined, visually cohesive interfaces. Build final assets, iconography, motion graphics, and mockups that balance form and function. Collaboration Collaborate across Design, Art, and Engineering disciplines to bring ideas from concept to shippable feature. Provide feedback in reviews and help maintain visual and UX consistency across the product. Stay current on trends in games, apps, and visual design to bring fresh thinking to the team. What Will Make You A Great Fit Experience shipping at least one AAA game or equivalent project. Strong portfolio showing a range of UI Art work and or UX Design work. Skilled in Figma using components for Atomic Design structures. Skilled in Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects (or equivalent) for UI asset creation and motion design. Comfortable working across teams - Design, Art, Engineering -to bring ideas to life. Strong communicator who gives and receives feedback with clarity and respect. Deep curiosity about games and a thoughtful approach to how UI supports the player experience. Beneficial Qualifications Background in graphic design, layout, and gestalt principles. Familiarity with implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG), including Blueprints, animations, and materials. Experience with UI shaders/materials and 2D FX for game engines. The pay range for this position in British Columbia at the start of employment is expected to be between CAD $78,400 and CAD $116,020 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Advisor Experience
jobs.descriptionText: Who We Are Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. The Role We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help define the Advisor Experience for Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs). Advisors own the client relationship, and what we build helps them engage, retain, and serve their clients on web and mobile. Advisors are often on the move, so a strong mobile experience is core to how they stay prepared and responsive to clients. You'll work with product and engineering leaders on its vision, strategy, and roadmap, including how AI surfaces insights, how integrations bring an advisor's tools and data into one place, and how we drive adoption across client segments. You're a senior individual contributor who leads through the quality of your work and the strength of your thinking. You learn how advisors actually work, and you design products they come to rely on every day. You test ideas early, learn from real users, and keep iterating until the evidence points to an answer. You're comfortable with ambiguity, and you can set direction while still getting the details right. You know a product only succeeds when people use it, and you design with that in mind. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B , F-1 /OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. What You’ll Do Provide design vision and thought leadership for the advisor persona across web and mobile experiences. Design mobile experiences that help advisors prepare for meetings, review client information, and act on insights wherever they are. Collaborate with other product and design teams so experiences connect seamlessly across the platform. Work closely with our research team to understand advisors and their support teams, stepping in to run your own studies when needed. Use those insights to define clear problems, guide design principles, and drive product decisions. Above all, be a tireless advocate for our clients. Prototype with AI and code to explore ideas quickly and test realistic interactions. Form hypotheses, prototype, test with users, and let the results guide the direction. Establish clear metrics for success alongside product leadership, integrating qualitative insights and quantitative metrics to shape design choices. Partner with engineering stakeholders to develop highly scalable and performant solutions. Accelerate product adoption. Partner across product, GTM, and customer teams to analyze adoption patterns and construct compelling narrative prototypes that showcase business value. Collaborate closely with the design system team to uphold our accessibility standards and core UI patterns, while crafting and contributing new component patterns to align with the advisor experience. Mentor designers, raise the bar for craft, and work with design leads to improve patterns, processes, and tools. Collect and provide feedback from peers, partners, and stakeholders. Who You Are 7+ years of experience working in the field of Product Design, Interaction Design, and/or UX Design. 1+ year in a design lead role. A track record of leading complex, ambiguous initiatives as a senior IC and setting design direction across teams. A portfolio that shows strong user-centered design, iterative problem solving, effective use of UI patterns, and solid visual design across responsive web and mobile. Experience designing native mobile apps, with a strong grasp of iOS and Android platform conventions. Hands-on experience running research and turning insights into product direction. Comfortable using qualitative insights and quantitative data together to make design decisions. Experience prototyping with AI tools and/or code, such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or front-end frameworks. A track record of distilling complex workflows and requirements into clear, scalable design solutions. A refined visual sensibility and the craft to make data-dense experiences feel clear, modern, and polished. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to align stakeholders around a vision. A self-starter and a great teammate who enjoys working in a fast-paced, agile environment. Experience with Figma, our preferred design tool. Experience designing AI-powered experiences or working in fintech is a strong plus. Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for this role within the United States. Compensation for this role includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Base Salary Range $172,000 — $215,000 USD Our Values Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com .
